name: #HEEL
Text: Cannot be played when you have a Face card in your Ring. Your opponent cannot respond to this card. Search your Arsenal for 1 printed Heel action, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. Your actions and antics are considered to be Heel, and your Redemption is blank.

name: (Air) Boom Drop!
Text: When you are Kofi Kingston, this card is -10F. When you have lower Fortitude, this card is -1F for each of your maneuvers in your Ringside or removed from the game. Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Cannot be reversed from Backlash. Draw up to 4 cards and put cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal equal to the cards you drew -2.

name: ...And I'm AWESOME!
Text: When Because I'm The Miz... is in your Ring, this card is -11F. As an action, cannot be reversed, put up to 2 non-unique cards from your Ringside into your hand. As a reversal, reverse any Mid-match or Superstar-specific card and discard 2 cards. ACE: During your turn you may put this card into your Ringside, and then look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and he removes the chosen card from the game.

name: ...The More I'm Gaining Ground
Text: When you have fewer reversals in Ring, this card is -12F. Reverse any maneuver, and put up to 2 maneuvers in your Ringside into your Backstage area.

name: ...The Sweeter the Juice
Text: When you have no Revolution cards or Pre-match D:1+cards in your Ring, this card is -3F. Reverse any non-Unique card; when The Older the Berry... is in your Ring, this card is -3F and reverse any card or non-damage card effect instead. When you are Mae Young, and this card and The Older the Berry... are in your Ring, your opponent must discard 1 card or overturn 1 card before each player's Draw Segment.

name: ...These Ladies Love Me For All My Cash
Text: When I Come From Money, I Come From Class is in your Ring, this card is -10F. As an action, cannot be reversed when your opponent is a Female superstar; draw up to 3 cards. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card and when he is a female superstar, he overturns 5 cards. When successfully played, you may reveal The Million Dollar Couple.

name: 10-Time WCW Tag Team Champions
Text: When you have only 1 Booker's Thrust Kick card in your Ring, it is Permanent. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put WCW Tag Team Title Belts from your Backlash or Ringside into your Ring. Replace the 'WCW Title Belt' text with 'WCW Tag Team Title Belts' on your Superstar-specific cards.

name: 10-Year Veteran
Text: When your opponent's Fortitude is at least 9F greater, reversals to this card are +8F. Shuffle up to 7 cards from your Ringside and up to 6 of your cards removed from the game into your Arsenal, he overturns 5 cards and randomly removes 4 cards in his Ringside from the game, draw 3 cards, he discards 2 cards, then search his Arsenal for 1 card and remove it from the game.

Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. Shuffle 2 cards removed from the game and 2 cards in your Ringside into your Arsenal, draw 1 card, and your opponent overturns 1 cards and discards 1 card. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and overturn 1 card, and when you use your Ability this turn, you may play a Superstar-specific card instead.

name: 2007 Diva Search Winner
Text: Put up to 1 Mid-match non-reversal from your Ringside in your Backlash, and then search your Arsenal for 2 cards with 'diva' or 'female' in the title or text, reveal them, put them in your hand, and shuffle. ACE: When this card is in your Ring or Ringside, you may remove 2 other random cards in your Ringside from the game, and then put this card in your Backlash and end your turn.

name: A Cool Double Team
Text: Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. When this card is in your Ring and the first card you play on your turn is a non-Unique non-Chain maneuver without 'reversed' in the text, your opponent may discard 2 cards; if he does not, the maneuver is now Multi and gains the text 'Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards.'

name: A Cool Dropkick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is +2D and +1 Stun Value, and it is considered non-Unique for your card effects; when you have lower Fortitude, this card can be played from Ringside. As a reversal, reverse any Unique maneuver and discard 1 card.

name: A Family Legacy
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Umaga-specific cards do not take up a Pre-match or Mid-match slot in your Ring. Your Samoan Drop is +3D. ACE: You may put this card into your Ringside and then put up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your hand: when the next card you play is a non-RMS Superstar-specific action with a logo on this card, your opponent cannot respond to it. When you are Umaga, this cannot be reversed.

name: A Giant Assist
Text: Cannot be blanked. Cannot be packed when packing Corners. When this card is in your Ring or Ringside, your reversals with 'manager' or 'nWo' in the title are F: 0 and are not affected by Playing By the Rules; when your Fortitude Rating is 10-, do not draw for their text. ACE: When you have used your Ability at least twice this turn and your maneuver is unsuccessfully played, you may put this card into your Ringside and then put up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand.

name: A Great Deal of Confusion
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: WCW. When played, you may ignore a 'can only be reversed' or 'cannot be reversed' effect from a card. Reverse any non-Superstar-specific card that 'cannot be reversed' or with a 'can only be reversed' effect. Draw up to 1 card, and put up to 1 card under Halloween Havoc and up to 1 of your cards removed from the game under Where the Big Boys Play.

name: A Group of Equals
Text: Cannot be blanked. Search your Arsenal for 4 The Corre-specific cards with different additional logos; reveal them, put them under this card, and shuffle. During your turn, you may put all cards under this card in your hand. ACE: During your turn when there are no cards under this card, you may put this card into your Ringside, shuffle 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and draw 4 cards.

name: A Hair-Razing Experience
Text: Cannot be packed by Gail Kim. Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, choose one: put Bald is Beautiful from your Backlash into your Ring, and it cannot be blanked or moved from your Ring; or search your Arsenal for It's Not a Wig!, put it under this card, and it is F: 0 and can be played as if from hand.

name: A Kwik Kick
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card; when you have a Face card in your Ring, can only be reversed by Superstar-specific reversals. As a reversal, reverse any card that allows your opponent to search any Area; when you have a Heel card in your Ring, you may also reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card.

name: A McCool Boot
Text: When played as a Counter (hand or Backlash), this card is Multi and he must discard 1 Backlash card to play a reversal to it.

name: A Punch That Would Take Someone's Head Off
Text: As a maneuver, your opponent discards 1 random card. As an action, this card is F: 0, put this card in your Backlash and draw 1 card. You cannot play this card as an action for the rest of the turn.

name: A-List Spinebuster
Text: When played as a maneuver, you may put 2 cards from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal and choose one: this card cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash. When played after a successfully played card, you may choose to put 2 additional cards from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal and choose both options.

name: Accompanied by A.J.
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Daniel Bryan-specific cards do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Once during each of your turns when you successfully play a maneuver, you may search your Arsenal for a maneuver of a different type that is not Unique, Revolution or a reversal; reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. ACE: When you search, you may overturn 5 cards and the maneuver does not have to be non-Unique.

name: Ain't No Grave Can Hold My Body Down
Text: Your Living Legend does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring, and ignore the 'Face' text. Your opponent cannot lower your Superstar Value, Starting Hand Size, or Pre-match capacity. ACE: During any turn, when he successfully plays a card with 'Pinfall' or 'Count Out' in the text, you may overturn 6 cards, remove that card from the game, and his card is considered to have not been played.

name: Air (Boom) Support
Text: When you are Kofi Kingston, your opponent cannot respond to this card. ACE: When he reverses your High Risk maneuver from hand or Backlash, you may put this card into your Ringside and put up to 2 maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand. When you are Kofi Kingston and he reverses this effect, choose 1 maneuver in his Ring and he puts it into his Ringside.

name: Alberto Del Rio
Text: When you would randomly discard cards or randomly remove cards from the game, you may choose the same number of cards from the same area instead. You may not pack Man of 1,000 Holds.

name: Alberto's Magnificent Cars
Text: Cannot be blanked. Search your Arsenal for 2 non-Superstar-specific Unique cards, reveal them, put them under this card, and shuffle. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card from under this card into your hand. When one of your maneuvers is unsuccessfully played, you may put Opulence from your Backlash or Ringside into your Ring.

name: All I've Got Left is My Pride
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Smackdown and either lower Fortitude or fewer cards in hand. Search your Arsenal for an F: 0 maneuver with blank text, put it in your Ring, and shuffle. You may remove any number of Pre-match cards in your Ring from the game, and then draw up to 1 card for each card moved from your Ring (up to 2 cards when the card moved is Smackdown).

name: All Will Suffer
Text: When your opponent plays a maneuver with a 'can only be reversed' effect from a card, you may ignore the restriction and reverse the maneuver. Overturn half the maneuver's damage, rounded up, and he discards 2 cards. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside and then overturn up to 3 cards and he overturns double that number of cards.

name: And I Quote...
Text: Put this card into your hand and when your next card played is not a maneuver, it is Multi, requires 3 reversals instead of 2, and your opponent cannot play cards with 'completely' in the text in response to it. You cannot play And I Quote... for the rest of the turn.

name: Anything I Do, I Dominate
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Can be played from Ringside. Bury your hand. Do not discard to your opponent's effects or draw during the Pre-match phase (except your Starting Hand), and your Hand Size cannot be modified by their effects. Once during each of your turns when your maneuver is successful, Bury #- Ringside cards (# = half the number of your Ring maneuvers). ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2, and then Arsenal Search 1 Strike and 1 Grapple that are not Unique or Hybrid; when this effect is reversed, continue the turn.

name: Are You Serious, Bro?
Text: When played, you may discard up to 2 cards with Activated Card Effects, and this card is -4F for each card discarded. Reverse any maneuver and put up to 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. ACE: During your turn, you may remove this card from the game and then your next Action played this turn is -8F and cannot be reversed by hybrid reversals.

name: Assaulted With Hairspray
Text: Can be played from the top of your Arsenal. Reverse any maneuver, your opponent discards 2 cards, and you draw up to 2 cards. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card, and then put up to 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Awesome Double Team
Text: Cannot be blanked. Reversals to this card deal no damage. All players discard 2 cards. When this card is unsuccessfully played, put this card and up to 1 card from Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Awesome Neckbreaker Combination
Text: When your opponent's Fortitude Rating is 10 or more and you have lower Fortitude, this card is -6F. When this card is in your Arsenal, it is considered non-Unique. When this card is in your Ring, it counts as 2 maneuvers. When this card is in your Ringside, during your turn you may shuffle it into your Arsenal.

name: Back Flip
Text: Can only be played when you are Carlito or Daniel Bryan, or when High-Flying Style is in your Ring. When played from hand, reverse any non-Unique maneuver and your opponent puts the reversed maneuver in his hand. When this card is in your Ring, your Hurricanrana cards are +1 Stun Value, and can only be reversed from hand and Arsenal.

name: Backed by Jinder Mahal
Text: Your Drawing a Blank is now a The Great Khali-specific card. Your opponent cannot prevent you from playing your Superstar-specific Pre-match cards, and when they would be removed from the game or put in your Ringside, put them in your Ring instead. During your turn, you may hide this card and shuffle up to 3 cards in your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Backed by Santino Marella
Text: Shuffle this card and up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and when your next card played this turn is a non-Unique maneuver, it can only be reversed by D: 0 reversals. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may discard 2 cards and then put this card into your hand and end your turn.

name: Backed by the Cole Miners
Text: As an action, draw 1 card for each Michael Cole-specific card in your Ring and your opponent discards 3 cards. As a reversal, reverse any Action or non-Trademark non-Trademark Finisher Superstar-specific card. When successfully played, shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Backed by The People
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, put 1 card in your hand or 1 card from your Ringside under this card; you may play that card as if from hand. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside and then when your next card played this turn is Patented Rock Footstomp, it is -5F and can only be reversed by Unique cards; after its damage is resolved, end your turn. When this card is moved from your Ring, put the card under it on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Backed by Virgil
Text: Put up to 3 cards removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal. ACE: During your turn, you may remove this card from the game and then your next maneuver played this turn can only be reversed from Arsenal. When this card is reversed when played or Activated, or when a maneuver affected by this card is reversed, put up to 3 cards removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Backed by Yamaguchi-san
Text: When packing this card, you are a Stable. When this card is revealed and you overturn a Multi maneuver or a Set-up action for your Ability, you may put that card in your hand instead of searching. You may hide this card and when the next card played this turn is We Are EVIL!, your opponent cannot respond to it.

name: Backpack Stunner
Text: When played after a successfully played card with 'lariat' in the title, this card is -5F and cannot be reversed by non-Unique cards from Backlash.

name: Baghdad, Iraq
Text: Cannot be packed by 1-2-3 Kid, Christy, Eve, Kane, Paul Burchill, Sandman or The Second Coming. When this card is in your Ring and you are not Muhammad Hassan or The Iron Sheik, before each of your Draw Segments, your opponent may overturn 1 card and flip 2 cards in his Ring face-down; if he does, you overturn 2 cards. ACE: Once during any players' turn, he may move this card from any Ring to any other Ring, and then discard 1 card and 1 Backlash card.

name: Barrett's Big Boot
Text: When you are The Corre, this card is Multi. ACE: When you are Wade Barrett and this card is in your Ring, you may put it on the bottom of your Arsenal to reverse a non-Superstar-Specific non-maneuver card.

name: Beat Him Up, Break His Neck
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your first non-Revolution maneuver with 'breaker' in the title played each turn is -10F and cannot be reversed from Backlash. You cannot reverse your opponent's first Action played of each of his turns from hand or Backlash. ACE: During your turn, you may remove this card from the game and then shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and he overturns 5 cards.

name: Beautiful Disaster
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -6F, and can only be played after a successfully played card; when played after a successfully played maneuver, can only be reversed by non-Face D: 0 reversal cards. As a reversal, reverse any Strike or Action.

name: Because I'm The Miz...
Text: This card requires 3 reversals to completely reverse instead of 2, and ignore 'completely' on your opponent's reversal cards and effects. Search your Arsenal for ...And I'm AWESOME!!!!!, reveal it, then search for 1 card, put all cards searched for in your hand and shuffle. Discard 1 less card for your Ability.

name: Beli-Eve
Text: Shuffle up to 4 RFG cards into your Arsenal, draw up to 3 cards, and your opponent overturns 2 cards and discards 1 card. ACE: When you use your Ability, you may remove 2 cards in your Ringside from the game and choose both options. Reversals to this effect do not end you turn.

name: Beware The COBRA!
Text: *This card is always considered revealed. Cannot be packed when packing non-Superstar-specific cards with ‘diva’ in the text. New Ability: Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 3 cards and Bury 1 Hand card, 1- Ringside card, and 1- RFG non-hybrid Reversal card, and then draw 1. When your Superstar-specific card is successful, you may Arsenal/Ringside Search COBRA! Replace ‘Antic’ with ‘Unique card’ on your Superstar-specific cards.’

name: Bone-Crushing 450 Splash
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played 8D+ maneuver. Search your opponent's Arsenal, choose 1 card, remove it from the game, and they shuffle; when you are Justin Gabriel, choose 1 additional card. During your turn when this card is in your hand, you may reveal it, draw 1 card, and shuffle this card into your Arsenal.

name: Boots to A$$es!
Text: Reveal the top 5 cards of your Arsenal, put any revealed maneuvers in your hand, and shuffle. As an action, shuffle up to 3 maneuvers in your Ringside into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card.

name: Brazillian Jiu-Jitsu Student
Text: Reverse any non-unique maneuver or Activated Card Effect and draw up to 3 cards.

name: Broski Boot
Text: As a maneuver, when played after a successfully played maneuver, this card is a High Risk instead of a Strike. As a reversal, reverse any card played after a Set-up card. ACE: During your opponent's turn, you may remove this card from the game to reverse a non-Unique maneuver with a Restricted Modification Symbol.

name: Broski of the Week
Text: Your opponent overturns 3 cards, shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and draw 1 card. ACE: Once during each of your turns, when you have greater Fortitude, you may put 1 maneuver from your Ring on the bottom of your Arsenal and then he discards 1 card and overturns 2 cards.

name: Bryan's Airplane Spin
Text: After all damage has been applied, discard 1 card and your opponent discards 2 cards. When your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, you may ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text. When this card has been removed from the game and you discard cards, put this card and up to 1 other card removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Bryan's Trademark Surfboard
Text: When played after a successfully played maneuver, cannot be reversed by non-Superstar-specific reversals from hand or Backlash. When this card is in your hand and you overturn cards, you may discard this card and 1 other card instead of overturning.

name: Bryan's Vicious Kick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F and +3D and when played after a successfully played Grapple or Submission maneuver, can only be reversed from Arsenal. As a reversal, when played from hand, reverse any Grapple or Submission.

name: Building Classic Momentum
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: WWF. Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or as a Counter (1D+ reversal to a maneuver). Can only be reversed by Unique reversals. When the next card played this turn is a maneuver with 'Classic' in the title, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text, it is +5D and can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Calling For The COBRA!
Text: This card is considered a Trademark Finisher in your Arsenal. You may discard 2 cards; if you do, put the top card and the bottom card of your opponent's Arsenal into his Ringside. Look at his hand, choose up to 1 card, and put it in his Ringside. Your Salute! Diving Headbutt is 'Trademark Finisher + High Risk' instead, -20F, and -10D.

name: Cause I'll End It All
Text: Completely reverse any card, even if it cannot be reversed. When this card reverses, even from Arsenal, put this card into your Backstage and put up to 2 of your cards removed from the game into your Ringside.

name: Censorship
Text: Put up to 1 card in your opponent's Ring into his Ringside, then choose 1 card in his Ring and that card is now blank. He discards 5 cards and overturns 5 cards.

name: Classic Arm Drag
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. All players draw 1 card.

name: Classic Back Kick
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. All players discard 1 random card; when you have Classic Competitor in your Backstage Area or you are Tajiri, discard 1 card instead.

name: Classic Body Slam
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When successfully played, you may reduce the damage of this move to 0. If you do, search your Arsenal for From the Top Rope or From the Middle Turnbuckle, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when that card is the next card played this turn, your opponent cannot respond to it.

name: Classic Boxing Jab
Text: When you are not Michael Tarver, can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Put 1 card from the bottom of your Arsenal into your hand. When you are Michael Tarver, you may search for this card as if it were non-Unique and when this card is successfully played, your opponent discards 1 random Backlash card.

name: Classic Clothesline
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. The Fortitude of this card cannot be increased or decreased.

name: Classic Double Axe Handle
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Can only be played after a successfully played 2D+ maneuver. Shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Classic Elbow Drop
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Can only be played after a successfully played 2D+ maneuver. When played after From The Top Rope, can only be reversed from hand or Arsenal.

name: Classic Lariat
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When played, discard up to 5 cards, this card is -1F and +1D for each card discarded.

name: Classic Leaping Knee
Text: When you are Brutus 'The Barber' Beefcake and this card is played after a successfully played maneuver, cannot be reversed. Your opponent discards 1 card.

name: Classic Leg Work
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When played after a maneuver with 'classic' in the title, this card is -4F.

name: Classic Neck Wrench
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Your opponent discards 1 card and removes the top card of his Arsenal from the game. You cannot play Maintain Hold after this card.

name: Classic Power Slam
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When played after Irish Whip or Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, this card is Multi.

name: Classic Sleeper Hold
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. When you are Rowdy Roddy Piper, The Rowdy One, or Brutus 'The Barber' Beefcake, this card is -2F and +1 Stun Value.

name: Classic Toss Out of the Ring
Text: Can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Draw 1 card. Your next card played this turn is considered to be played after Throw Opponent Out of the Ring.

name: COBRA!
Text: As a maneuver, can only be reversed from Arsenal. As an action, this card is -40F and your opponent cannot respond to it, draw 1 card and shuffle this card into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring and Beware The COBRA! is revealed, before each of your Draw Segments, your opponent overturns 1 card.

name: Cody Rhodes
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may reveal the top 2 cards of your Arsenal, choose 1 card, and put both cards on the bottom of your Arsenal. Your opponent reveals 2 random cards from hand and you choose one; when his chosen card is the same card type as your chosen card, then you may discard 1 card and he puts his chosen card on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Cody's Protective Face Mask
Text: Can only be revealed when you play From Dashing to Disfigured. When this card is revealed, no player can move maneuvers in your Ring or Ringside from the game with non-Superstar-specific cards or effects, and when your opponent causes you to discard cards, the number of cards discarded is reduced to 1. When this card is hidden, once during each of your turns you may remove 1 card with 'face' or 'mask' in the title in your hand or Ringside from the game and draw 2 cards.

name: Cole-Cocked
Text: Can only be reversed by Quick Reflexes. Once during each of your turns, when this card is in your Ringside, you may overturn 2 cards and put this card into your hand.

name: Collegiate Wrestling Skill
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Corners, except Revolution Kurt Angle is In My Corner! When you have lower Fortitude, ignore 'Can only be played...' on your Leapfrog Stungun, your Superstar-specific actions are Multi, and once during each of your turns, you may search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique F:0 maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Come At Me, Bro!
Text: Reverse any non-maneuver card and draw up to 1 card. ACE: During your turn, you may remove this card from the game, and then put 1 non-Unique D: 0 card in your Ringside with an Activated Card Effect into your Ring.

name: Connecting With the WWE Universe
Text: *This card is always considered to be revealed. Cannot be packed by a Legend (except Mick Foley) or Cryme Tyme. Packed: you can only pack 1 other non-'Shenanigans' non-Superstar-specific Backstage card (unless you are Mick Foley), and you can pack 8- 'Cheap Pop' cards (when you are Mick Foley, 12-) in your Backstage; at the end of the Pre-match phase, reveal and Recover them. Your first 'Cheap Pop' card played each turn cannot be reversed by Hybrid or BASH reversals. Your Get Crowd Support and Cheap Accolades are -#F (# = your Ring 'Cheap Pop' cards).

name: Connection Teamwork
Text: When you have at least 5 lower Fortitude, this card is F: 0. When this card is unsuccessful, draw 1 card and shuffle this card and up to 1 other card in your Ringside into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ringside and you use your Ability, you may put this card into your hand.

name: Cougar Splash
Text: This card is also considered a High Risk for your effects. Can only be played after a successfully played card. When that card was a 5D+ maneuver, this card is Multi, +5D, and +2 Stun Value.

name: Cross Rhodes
Text: Cannot be reversed from Backlash. When successfully played by Cody Rhodes, your opponent chooses one: he discards 4 cards or shuffles his hand into his Arsenal.

name: D-Von's Flying Lariat
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When played after a successfully played maneuver, cannot be reversed by non-Unique reversals. During your turn, when you are D-Von Dudley and this card is in your hand or Ringside, you may reveal it, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, and draw 1 card.

name: Dancin' With Little Jimmy
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When your next card played this turn is a maneuver, it is +2D and your opponent's reversals to it are +12F. When this card is reversed, put up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Dancing Finale
Text: When you are about to lose the game, you may put this card from your Backlash or Ringside into your Ring, discard 2 cards, shuffle up to 10 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, draw 2 cards, and end the current turn. When you are Too Cool, discard 1 less card for your Ability.

name: Dangerous F-5
Text: As a maneuver, this card is not affected by The Most Dangerous Champions of SmackDown!; can only be played after a successfully played maneuver and cannot be reversed from Backlash. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple or Submission. This card is considered 2 cards for your card effects.

name: Daniel Bryan
Text: When you have 3 or more cards with different maneuver types in your Ring and you successfully play a maneuver, choose one: put 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal or draw 1 card. You may reverse a maneuver by removing random cards in your Ringside from the game equal to the damage of the maneuver +1. You may pack The NXT Breakout Star.

name: Daniel's Dangerous Dive
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card; when played after a 5D+ maneuver, cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash by non-Unique cards. When unsuccesfully played, overturn 5 cards. As a reversal, when played from hand, reverse any non-maneuver card when it is not your opponent's first card played this turn. When successfully played, he discards 1 random card.

name: Darren Young
Text: When you successfully play a maneuver, discard 1 card and then your opponent randomly discards 1 Backlash card; when his discarded card is a Pre-match card, he overturns 3 cards; when it is a reversal, shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal; otherwise, draw up to 2 cards.

name: David Otunga
Text: Draw 2 additional cards during each of your Draw Segments, and at the end of your turn, put 2 cards from hand on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Deflating Your Ego
Text: This card is considered non-Unique for your opponent's reversals. When this card is reversed, draw up to 2 cards. During his next turn, his non-F: 0 cards are +10F. Ignore the 'before the Draw Segment of the first turn of the game' text on your Overrated Superstar.

name: Del Rio's Enzuigiri
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F and can only be reversed by Unique reversals. As a reversal, reverse any Activated Card Effect or non-maneuver card. When successfully played, your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Del Rio's Scarf
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you do not have Ring Psychology: Arm in your Ring or it is blank, your non-Revolution maneuvers with 'arm' or 'wrist' in the title are -4F and +4D and when you successfully play a maneuver with 'arm' or 'wrist' in the title, you may draw 1 card.

name: Demolition Beatdown
Text: When played as a Counter (from a card with a Tag Logo), cannot be reversed from Backlash. Search your Arsenal and Ringside for Instruments of Destruction, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Dirty Dancing Specialist
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 card and reveal it, and then shuffle that card and up to # cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, where # is equal to the revealed card's damage and cannot be greater than 8.

name: Diva Camel Clutch

name: Initiation into New Nexus
Text: Cannot be packed when packing I'm Gonna Break You. Remove any number of Backlash cards from the game. If you removed at least 3 cards from the game, you may increase your Starting Hand Size by +4. If you removed at least 6 cards, you start the game. If you removed at least 9 cards, his effects that would make you discard cards are reduced to 1. If you removed at least 12 cards, he cannot respond to your first printed F:0 D:6- maneuver played of the game, and after its damage is applied, end your turn.

name: Internet Championship Title Belt
Text: Your Slandered Online cards do not take up a Pre-match slot into your Ring, and ignore their 'if you and your opponent have the same total Superstar Value' text. At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for 1 Superstar-specific card, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may put Slandered Online from your Ring into your Ringside and then your next card played this turn is -2F for each card with 'bro' in the title in all players' Rings. Superstar Value +0

name: It Is My Destiny!
Text: Can only be played when you have lower Fortitude. When this card is in your hand, Ringside, or Ring you may reveal it, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, remove 1 random card in your Ringside from the game, and shuffle 1 card in your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: It's a Shame That They Lost Their Heads
Text: Your maneuvers are +1D for every maneuver in your Backstage Area. During your turn you may hide this card, shuffle up to # cards into your Arsenal and draw up to 2 cards, and your opponent overturns # cards, where # is the number of maneuvers in your Backstage Area.

name: It's Time For...Real Talk!
Text: Reverse any non-Unique non-maneuver card and draw 1 card. Once during each of your turns, when you play a non-Active non-Multi action, you may play another card with the same title. Unless both cards are reversed when played, both are considered successfully played.

name: Ivory's Censored Driver
Text: When you have lower Fortitude, this card is -8F and your opponent's reversals to it are +12F. When played against a female Superstar, this card is +6D. Search your Arsenal or Ringside for a Right To Censor-specific Action card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Ivory: Conservative Champion
Text: Cannot be blanked, and does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. At the end of the Pre-match phase when Censorship Match is not in your Ring, look at your opponent's hand, choose 2 non-reversal cards, he puts them on the bottom of his Arsenal and draws 1 card. When you are not packing We Will BASH You... For Your Own Good!, your Superstar-specific Actions cards are Multi and -4F. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may shuffle 2 cards from your hand into your Arsenal and then name a non-Superstar-specific card, that is now the card chosen for Censorship Match.

name: Jericho's Flashy LED Jacket
Text: Your opponent cannot search your Arsenal or look at your Backlash for your printed Feuds. Your non-reversal Superstar-specific cards are considered to be titled ‘STF’, ‘DDT’, and ‘Suplex’ for your printed Feuds. Replace ‘your Superstar Ability’ with ‘your Superstar-specific cards’ on your Happy You're Here, Happier You're Gone.

name: John Morrison
Text: When cards played would remove cards in your Arsenal, Ring, or Ringside from the game, you may choose half those cards (rounded down) and put them on the bottom of your Arsenal instead; you cannot choose more than 5 cards. You can pack High-Flying Style, but you cannot pack High Risks with 'can only be reversed' in the text.

name: Juan Deere Tractors
Text: Packed: you are a Stable and your We're Not Mexicans... We're Mexicools! is not Cheater. Your Lawn Maintenance Professionals and High-Flying Style cannot be blanked or blocked, do not take up a Ring slot, and double the numbers in the text. You may increase your Hand Size by 3.

name: Justin Gabriel
Text: Your '#D' text on your High Risk maneuvers is now '0D', and when you successfully play a High Risk, shuffle up to 1 card removed from the game into your Arsenal. You may pack High-Flying Style.

name: Juvi Driver
Text: When you have lower Fortitude or fewer cards in hand, this card is Multi. As an action, this card is F: 5, search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it in your hand, and then shuffle this card into your Arsenal.

name: Keep On Truckin'
Text: Ignore 'non-Unique' in your Ability. When your maneuver played from hand is unsuccessfully played, you may put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead. During your turn you may hide this card and then put up to 5 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: King Sheamus
Text: Draw 2 cards, and shuffle up to 4 cards in your Ringside into your Arsenal. Your opponent discards 2 cards and overturns 4 cards, and he randomly removes 1 of the overturned cards from the game.

name: Kung Fu (Naki) Kick
Text: As a reversal, reverse any card that cannot be reversed.

name: Lawler's Big Right Hand
Text: Cannot be reversed by No Sell Maneuver. As a maneuver, when unsuccessfully played, put this card into your hand instead. As a reversal, when you have lower Fortitude, or your opponent is Michael Cole or Jack Swagger, reverse any Strike or Action card. When successfully played and your next card played is The Straps Are Down, he cannot respond to it it.

name: Lay-Cool
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 1 card and then your opponent reveals 1 random card from Backlash, it is blank until the end of the turn, and he discards that card. Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 8D+ maneuver, and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-hybrid 7D- maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. He cannot play cards with 'Layla' or 'McCool' in the title. You are a Tag Team. You may not pack Set-up cards.

name: Legendary Fan Favorite
Text: As an action, shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and put up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand. When this card is reversed, you may put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead. As a reversal, when overturned reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver and when you have fewer maneuvers in Ring, you may put this card into your hand instead.

name: Legendary Guest Host
Text: Your Unique maneuvers also count as non-Unique for your effects, ignore 'Can be reversed...' on your 'Classic' maneuvers, and ignore 'You may not search...' on Beat You Raw. Once during each of your turns, you may RFG 1 Hand Raw or 'Classic' card and Bury 2- Ringside non-reversal Raw and/or 'Classic' cards.

name: Legendary Ruthlessness
Text: Can only be packed by a Legend. When you are not packing The New Legends of the WWE, can only be played when you have lower Fortitude. When you are packing Classic Competitor, this card is -5F. Reverse any non-maneuver card and shuffle up to 2 cards in your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Legendary Tag Team Champions
Text: Can only be packed by Road Warriors. When packing this card, you may pack any number of title belts with 'Tag' in your Backstage Area, they are not Raw or Smackdown. After all Pre-match cards are played, before drawing your Starting Hand Size, put all Title Belts in your Backstage Area into your Ring. Title Belts do not increase your Superstar Value. You are a WCW Superstar.

name: Lex's Powerful Press Slam
Text: When played after a maneuver with 'dynamic' in the title, this card cannot be reversed from hand. As a maneuver, your opponent discards 2 cards. As an action, this card is -15F, discard this card and then search your Arsenal or Ringside for 1 card with 'dynamic' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand and shuffle. You cannot play actions with 'dynamic' in the title for the rest of the turn.

name: Liberated
Text: When you play From Dashing to Disfigured, hide this card. When you use your Ability and reveal a Cody Rhodes-specific card, your discarded card is put on the bottom of your Arsenal instead, and after using your Ability, you may shuffle. When this card is hidden, you may discard 1 card to reduce the damage of your opponent's successfully played card by 2D.

name: Light It Up For the Godfather
Text: As an action, draw up to 5 cards or search your Arsenal for up to 2 actions, reveal them, put them into your hand, and shuffle. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver. Discard 1 less card when Activating Pimpin' Ain't Easy!.

name: Limitless Power
Text: During your turn, you may hide this card and draw # cards, where # cannot be greater than 6. Skip your next 2 Draw Segments, and at the end of your second turn from now, discard # cards. During your opponent's turn, when your Fortitude Rating is 10 or greater, you may hide this card to reverse any non-Superstar-specific card, remove it from the game, and he discards 1 card.

name: Losers Like You Have No Heart!
Text: Cannot be played when your opponent is The Miz. Reverse any non-Unique card and draw up to 1 card. His Unique Superstar-specific cards gain the text, 'Can only be played when you have 3 or more cards in your hand. Discard 2 cards.'

name: Luck Is For Losers
Text: Cannot be blanked. Cannot be packed when packing cards with 'blood' or 'interest' in the title. At the end of the Pre-match phase, put up to 1 card from hand under this card (up to 2 cards when It's Hard Being This Original is in your Ring), and up to 1 card from Ringside for each copy of Old School Psychology in your opponent's Ring under this card, when you are CM Punk, draw up to 1 card. During your turn, you may play cards under this card as if from hand.

name: M!
Text: Cannot be reversed when played after R! or when W!, O! and R! are in your Ring. Search your Arsenal, Ringside, or cards removed from the game for 1 card, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Macho Man Joins the Wolfpack
Text: When packing this card, you may pack Macho Man Randy Savage maneuvers, they are now nWo cards, and ignore the 'with 'blindside' in the title' text in them. Your Backstage cards with 'shenanigans' in the title do not count towards your Ability. During your turn when you have at least 10 lower Fortitude, you may hide this card and put 1 nWo non-Trademark Finisher maneuver from your Ringside into your hand; when your next card played is an nWo non-Trademark Finisher maneuver, it is F: 0 and when your Fortitude Rating is 8 or less, it cannot be reversed from hand.

name: Mae Young's Slap
Text: Can only be reversed by Step Aside. When you successfully play Puppies! Puppies! and this card is in your Ring or Ringside, or removed from the game, you may put it into your hand.

name: Making Your Escape
Text: Your opponent's effects cannot prevent you from playing this card. Can be played from Ringside. Any player's First of All and Hell in a Cell Match are blank until the start of their first turn. When Redemption is in your Ring, it is blank. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may either overturn 4 cards or remove 1 Pre-match card in your Ring from the game, and then you are not affected by his Hell In A Cell Match, There Is No Escape, or First of All until the start of your next turn, and he is considered to have not played a Volley card on his last turn. This effect cannot be reversed.

name: Managed by Sunny
Traits: Universally Unique, Fan Favorite, WWF Classic
Text: Can only be packed by a Legend or WWF Superstar. When this card is put into your Ring, you may put 1 card from hand under this card. Cards under this card may be played as if from hand. ACE: When your opponent plays a maneuver, you may put this card into your Ringside and then your reversal played to it is -5F and deals no damage. When this card is in your Ringside, you may overturn 3 cards, put it in your Ring, and end your turn.

name: Managed by Vickie Guerrero
Logos: Dolph Ziggler, Lay-Cool, Chavo Guerrero, Jack Swagger, Leader of the Edge Army
Text: When packing this card, your Backed by SmackDown! GM Vickie Guerrero is now Superstar-specific; when this card is in your Ring and you do not have a Corner in your Ring, ignore the 'non-Superstar-specific' text on your Backed by SmackDown! GM Vickie Guerrero. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may search for 1 non-Unique maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. Your maneuvers are -2F for each card with µinterfere' in the title in your Ring.

name: Mandible Claw
Text: This card is -9F when Mr. Socko is in your Ring. When your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, you may ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on it. When you reveal this card for The Official Matching Jackets, draw 1 card.

name: Mankind's Mask
Text: When you would discard for Armageddon Is Upon Us, discard 2 cards instead. Your Double Arm DDT is a Trademark Finisher and can reverse any non-Unique Grapple instead. Your Mid-match Capacity is +1 for each Immune to Pain card in your Ring. Your Battling the Voices and Mind Games are F:0 and cannot be reversed.

name: Mark Henry
Text: Once during any player's turn, when you discard any number of cards for your opponent's effects, you may then draw 1 card. Ignore the 'of 4D or less' text on your Clumsy Opponent cards. You may pack As Big And Tough As Any Two Men. You cannot pack High Risks that do not have 'splash' in the title.

name: Maryse
Text: Play with the top card of your Arsenal revealed. Before you draw any number of cards, you may put the top 2 cards of your Arsenal on the bottom of your Arsenal. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card with the same title as the top card of your Arsenal from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. You may not pack Set-up cards or 4D+ Grapples.

name: Maryse's French Finesse
Text: When the top card of your Arsenal is a reversal and your opponent reverses your maneuver, you may put this card into your Ring. Once during each of your turns, when the card on top of your Arsenal does not have an Activated Card Effect, you may put it into your Ringside. When this card is in your Ring, it gains any Activated Card Effects from the card on top of your Arsenal.

name: Maryse's Wicked Slap
Text: As a maneuver, this card is +5D, and when the top card of your Arsenal is a maneuver or reversal, can only be reversed by D: 0 reversal cards. As a reversal, reverse any Strike or Action and draw up to 1 card.

name: Maryse: Femme Fatale
Text: Cannot be packed by The Godfather. Discard any number of cards, and your opponent overturns the same number of cards. Reveal the top card of your Arsenal and if it is a maneuver, he overturns 2 cards; if it is an Action, you discard 2 cards.

name: Mason Ryan's Sit-out Slam
Text: As a maneuver, cannot be reversed from Backlash when played after a successfully played card. As a reversal, reverse any Superstar-specific maneuver and discard 1 card.

name: May I Have Your Attention Please
Text: When played from hand, reverse any non-Superstar specific maneuver and put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand. When overturned, you may put this card into your hand.

name: McMahon Intervention
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: McMahonism. Your opponent cannot respond to this card. When playing this card and Divine Intervention is in your hand, you may remove it from the game; if you do, this card is -20F. Draw 12 cards, then put 8 cards from hand and up to 8 cards from Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Messin' With Little Jimmy
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Superstar Value is +1. Remove 1 card in your opponent's Ring or Ringside with 'Jimmy' or 'Management' in the title from the game. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and put 1 card from hand on top of your Arsenal, and then he chooses one: he discards 1 random Backlash card, you may shuffle 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw 1 card, or he removes the top 2 cards of his Arsenal from the game; when this effect is reversed, your turn continues.

name: Michael Cole
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards, name a card, and then your opponent reveals his hand; choose 1 card with the named card title and he discards the chosen card; for the rest of the turn, you cannot play non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver cards, or maneuvers with 'Can only be reversed' in the text. You can pack Two-Time Slammy Winner. You cannot pack Steel Chain Shot or Corners.

name: Michael Tarver
Text: When you successfully play a card with 'punch' in the title, you may draw 1 card and your opponent discards 1 card; when it is unsuccessful, search your Arsenal for a non-Unique card with 'punch' in the title with equal or lower Fortitude than the printed Fortitude of the reversed card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Mick Foley
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may shuffle 3 cards in your Ring with 'cheap' in the title into your Arsenal, and then put 1 card in your opponent's Ring into his Ringside. For every 2 cards in your Ring with 'cheap' in the title, your Fortitude Rating is +1F and his maneuvers are -1D. Your Superstar-specific Actions can only be reversed by Superstar-specific reversals, and his card effects cannot prevent you from playing with 'cheap pop' in the title. You may pack Have a Nice Day!, Mandible Claw, Mr. Socko, Psychedelic Dance Fever, Three Faces of Foley, and Tree Of Woe. You cannot pack Corners, Managers, Run-ins, or You Talkin' To Me?

name: Mighty Molly!
Text: Cannot be packed by a Tag Team. When you are Molly Holly, this card is F: 0. As an action, search your Arsenal for up to 3 maneuvers, reveal them, put them in your hand and shuffle. As a reversal, reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver and put up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your hand. When your next card played is a maneuver, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text.

name: Mixing Up the Wardrobe
Text: As an action, put up to 3 cards in your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal, overturn the same number of cards, then put up to the same number of cards from your Ringside into your hand and up to the same number of cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique hybrid card or any card with a Restricted Modification Symbol.

name: Miz's Corner Clothesline
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D+ maneuver or Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle. Cannot be played after From the Top Rope. Can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Miz's Trademark DDT
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card or as a Counter. Cannot be reversed by non-Unique reversals from hand or Backlash.

name: Molly Holly
Text: Your Submissions and Holds are +1D for each face-down card in your Ring. Your Molly Holly-specific cards are not Raw. You cannot pack Deadly Diva Duo, Evening Gown Match, or Skirt vs Skirt Match.

name: Molly's Double-Clutch Hold
Text: Ignore 'completely' on your opponent's reversals to this card. Draw up to 2 cards, flip over up to 2 cards in your Ring, and shuffle up to 2 of your cards removed from the game into your Arsenal.

name: Molly's Face Stretch
Text: As a maneuver, when your Fortitude Rating is 5-, this card is -5F and -8D. As an action, can only be played when you have 5+ lower Fortitude; put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and when the next card played this turn is printed F: 0 and either a Submission or Hold, your opponent cannot respond to it. When this card is unsuccessful, put it in your hand instead and he discards 1 card.

name: Morrison's Corkscrew Kick
Text: As a maneuver, when you have lower Fortitude, this card is F:0; can only be reversed by D: 0 reversals. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific Strike.

name: Morrison's Shining Wizard
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Cannot be reversed when you have lower Superstar Value. When you have greater Superstar Value, shuffle up to 2 of your cards removed from the game into your Arsenal.

name: Mr. 1.9 Seconds
Text: When this card would be discarded or removed from the game, put it in your Backlash instead. Draw 1 card, shuffle up to 9 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and your opponent overturns cards equal to the number of cards with 'punch' in the title in your Ring.

name: Mr. Rocko
Text: When this card would be removed from the game, put it in your Ringside instead. Search your opponent's Arsenal for 1 card, he puts the chosen card into his Ringside and shuffles. His cards are -2D. ACE: During your turn when this card is in your Ring or Ringside, you may discard 2 cards and then put 1 non-reversal card from your Ringside into your Backlash and end your turn.

name: Mr. Socko
Text: Search your Arsenal and Ringside for 1 card, reveal it, put it in your hand, shuffle, and overturn 1 card. When this card is in your Ring, your maneuvers are +1D and when you are The Rock and Sock Connection, your opponent's cards are -#D, where # is one-third the number of The Rock-specific cards in your Ring, rounded up. When this card is in your Ringside, you are The Rock and Sock Connection, and you use your Ability, you may put this card into your Ring.

name: Mr. Wrestlemania
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put Wrestlemania from your Backlash into your Ring. When you Activate Wrestlemania, it cannot be reversed; you may remove it from the game instead, and you may shuffle up to 5 non-reversal cards removed from the game into your Arsenal.

name: My Name... My Name is Alberto Del Rio!
Text: Can only be played as your first card of your first turn, and your opponent cannot respond to it. Shuffle any number of cards from your hand into your Arsenal and draw the same number of cards +1. During your turn, you may discard this card from Backlash to draw 2 cards.

name: New Nexus
Text: Once during each of your turns, when you have at least 3 cards in your Arsenal, you may overturn 3 cards and your opponent discards 3 cards; when your turn ends, he draws 1 card. You may pack CM Punk Arsenal cards, but you may not pack Thrust Knee Lift or Set-up cards. Your Chain cards are not Chain.

name: No Class, No Taste, No Shirt, $#!t Faced!
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Raw. When your next card played this turn is The Sex, the Gods, the Freaks, the Frauds., your opponent cannot respond to it.

name: No Fear, No Doubt, All In, Balls Out!
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Raw. Discard cards from your hand until you have 2 cards in hand. Look at your opponent's Backlash, choose 1 non-superstar-specific card, and he discards the chosen card. When your next card played this turn is a 9D- Trademark Finisher, he cannot respond to it; when it is a 10D+ Trademark Finisher and it is not reversed, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: No More Shenanigans
Text: Replace 'non-Enforcer, non-Superstar cards' with 'non-Superstar-specific Backstage cards without 'Shenanigans' in the title' on all Backstage Shenanigans cards. When your opponent Activates The Intensity of Ten Cities, you may overturn 1 card and remove that card from the game instead. When you would discard your hand or Backlash to his effects, you may instead discard # random cards, where # is half the number of cards to be discarded (rounded down).

name: No One Is Bigger Than The Business
Text: Reverse any Superstar-specific card and you may put it in your opponent's Ring instead. When this card is in your Ring, your non-hybrid non-Mean Triple H maneuvers are Trademark Finishers instead, and when he successfully plays a card with 'Triple H', 'GM', 'Chairman', or 'Business' in the title or text, draw up to 2 cards.

name: No Sweat!
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is 5 or less and you have lower Fortitude, this card is F: 0 and cannot be reversed. Draw up to 3 cards, and put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Nobody Gets Heat Like the Heartbreak Kid!
Text: Draw 2 cards, overturn up to 4 cards, and then shuffle up to # Heat reversals removed from the game into your Arsenal, where # is the number of cards overturned +2.

name: Now Listen... This Ain't No Make Believe!
Text: This card may be moved into your Arsenal. When this card is overturned, or during your turn when it is in your hand, you may put this card into your Ring. ACE: During your turn, you may shuffle this card into your Arsenal and then look at your opponent's hand and choose 1 card; he draws 1 card and then shuffles the chosen card into his Arsenal.

name: O!
Text: Cannot be reversed when played after W! Cannot be moved from your Ring by your opponent's reversals. ACE: When you successfully play a D: 2 card, you may overturn 2 cards and then shuffle 2 cards from Ringside into your Arsenal. When this effect is reversed, your turn does not end. Search your Arsenal and Ringside for R!, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Oh Radio, Tell Me Everything You Know...
Text: ACE: When you successfully play an action, you may overturn 1 card and your next non-Unique maneuver this turn is Multi. ACE: When you successfully play a non-Unique maneuver, you may discard 1 card and then put 1 non-Unique action from your Ringside into your hand. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, put 1 card in your Ring with an Activated Card Effect into your Ringside or discard 3 cards, and then put this card into your Ring.

name: Oi! Listen Here, Fella!
Text: As an action, draw up to 2 cards, and your opponent cannot reverse your Sheamus-specific Activated Card Effects this turn. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific Action. When successfully played, put up to 2 cards from your hand into your Backstage Area, and put up to the same number of cards from your Ringside into your Backstage Area.

name: Old School Raw
Text: Requirement: Back To Basics in your Ring. As an event, -9F;  at the end of the Pre-match phase, put any number of non-'Psychology' non-Unique 'Old School' cards from your Backlash into your Ring. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific Throwback. Your opponent may overturn 4, when they do not, RFG the reversed card. In Ring: double the numbers on your Old School Beating; the ACE on your non-Unique 'Old School' card cannot be reversed and their Recovery cannot be prevented or reduced.

name: Old School Shenanigans
Text: Your opponent's Break It Out, Break You Down, Breakin' Rules, Breakin' Ground is Active, and his Old School Psychology is Active unless Back To Basics is in his Ring. When you would discard for WWE Women's Championship Belt, you may overturn 2 cards instead. When he is Eugene, his Ability cannot be blanked or switched, he cannot play Superstar-specific 4D+ reversals, his maneuvers with Momentum do not have it, and he cannot play or use effects from Virtual Superstar-specific cards without his logo, or There Is No Escape.

name: Oozing Machismo
Text: When you are Razor Ramon, this card is -15F. Draw up to # cards, where # is equal to the number of Heel cards in your Ring and cannot be greater than 4. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 Heel card and then your opponent discards 2 cards. When this card is moved from your Ring, put 1 Heel card from your Ringside into your hand. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may allow him to draw 2 cards, then put this card into your Backlash.

name: Opulence
Text: When this card is in your Ring, your Ring Psychology: Arm is blank and when you play a maneuver, choose 1 maneuver in your opponent's Ring; when that maneuver can be flipped, he may flip that maneuver face-down, and if he does not, your played maneuver has the text of the chosen card instead until it is resolved. When you successfully play a maneuver, he may remove 3 random cards in his Ringside from the game, and then put this card from your Ring into your Backlash. ACE: When you have lower Fortitude, you may put this card into your Backlash and when your next card played this turn is a non-Unique maneuver, he cannot play non-Unique reversals to it. This effect cannot be reversed.

name: Otunga's Custom Apparel
Text: When this card is revealed or in your Ring, and you overturn cards for The NXT Breakout Star, you may put 1 of those cards under The 'It' Factor instead. When you would discard cards or put cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal, you may put this card from your Backstage Area into your Ring instead.

name: Out of Nowhere
Text: As an action, Arsenal, Ringside, and Removed From Game Search 1 Trademark Finisher; reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When your next card played this turn is a Trademark Finisher, it is F: 0 and ignore the 'Can only be played...' text, and when you have lower Fortitude it now reads 'Can only be reversed from Arsenal.' until the end of the turn. As a reversal, this card is F: 0, when overturned and you have 15- cards in your Arsenal, completely reverse any card or card effect and put this card in your Ring (regardless of other effects); you may play this card as your first card on your next turn as if from hand and your opponent cannot respond to it.

name: Pain and Destruction
Text: When you have at least 15 lower Fortitude, this card is F: 0 and your opponent cannot respond to it. Put up to 2 maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand and shuffle up to 10 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards and then put 1 card with a title in the text of Here Comes The Ax, Here Comes The Smasher from your Ringside into your hand; when you have no maneuvers in your Ring, this effect cannot be reversed.

name: Paper Bag
Text: During your turn, you may put this card from your Backlash into your opponent's Ring, on top of a card that is not Superstar-specific, Permanent, or RMS. The card under this card is not considered to be in his Ring, and this card does not take up a Mid-match slot in his Ring. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 2 cards, and then discard 2 cards and put this card in its owner's Ringside; when this effect is reversed, your turn continues. When your turn ends and this card is your Ringside, you may discard 2 cards and then put this card in your Backlash.

name: Parkour-Inspired Dive
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When there is a card in any player's Ring with 'anywhere', 'barricade', 'cage', or 'top rope' in the title, this card is +3D and +1 Stun Value. Once during each of your turns, you may reveal this card from hand or Ringside, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, and draw 1 card.

name: Personification of Domination
Text: Reversals to this card deal no damage and when it is reversed, your turn continues. As an action, this card is F: 0, your opponent discards 3 cards and overturns 3 cards, look at his Backlash and choose 1 card, and he discards the chosen card. As a reversal, reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver and search for 1 Superstar-specific non-reversal card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when that card is the first card played on your next turn, he cannot play non-unique reversals to it.

name: Pimps Up...You Know The Rest
Text: Your Pre-match Capacity is +1 for each The Godfather-specific Pre-match card in your Ring, and your opponent cannot prevent you from playing them. During your turn, you may hide this card, remove all Action: Run-ins in your Ring from the game, and shuffle the same number of cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Pin-Up Strong
Text: Revealed: Before your Draw Segment, you may put this card in your Ring. When your opponent plays a card with 'diva' or 'female' in the title or text, you may Arsenal Search 1 'Pretty Little' card and put it in your Ring. In Backstage: Once during each of your turns, Bury 1- Ringside non-reversal card. In Ring: discard 1 less card to use your Ability; ACE: when you use your Ability, you may discard 1 and then the maneuver can be any maneuver type.

name: Poised and Graceful
Text: When successfully played, search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it in your hand, and shuffle. As an action, shuffle this card into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card and overturn 3 cards.

name: Pourquoi?
Text: Cannot be blanked. When the top card of your Arsenal is a maneuver, your maneuvers without 'reversed' in the text are +5D; when it is a reversal, your opponent plays with his hand revealed; and when it is an action, his reversals deal no damage.

name: Preparing for One Hell of a Match
Text: *This card is always considered to be revealed. Cannot be packed by a Legend (except The Devil's Favorite Demon) or Torrie Wilson. Packed: you can only pack 1 other non-'Shenanigans' non-Superstar-specific Backstage card (unless you are The Devil's Favorite Demon), and you can pack 6- 'The Hell' cards (when you are The Devil's Favorite Demon, 9-) in your Backstage; at the end of the Pre-match phase, reveal and Recover them. Your 'The Hell' cards cannot be blocked, and when they are successful your opponent does not draw.

name: Primo Makes the Save!
Text: When this card is hidden and your opponent successfully plays a card that would remove a D: 1+ card from your Ring, you may reveal this card (when you are Carlito, you must also discard 4 cards), and your card is not removed from your Ring.

name: Prince of Parkour
Text: You may ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on any maneuver with 'rope', 'turnbuckle', 'barricade', or 'table' in the title or text. During your turn you may hide this card, remove 2 cards in your Ring from the game, and then remove 1 non-F: 0 maneuver in your opponent's Ring from the game.

name: PRO Carlito
Text: Can only be packed by a Rookie. During your turn, you may hide this card and draw 3 cards, and all players discard 1 card; when you are Michael Tarver, you may also put 1 D:0 card in your opponent's Ring into his Ringside.

name: PRO Chris Jericho
Text: Can only be packed by a Rookie. When you are Wade Barrett, at the end of the Pre-match phase you may look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 non-Superstar-specific card, he shuffles it into his Arsenal and draws 1 card. During his turn when he has successfully played more than 1 non-maneuver card, you may hide this card and then end his turn.

name: PRO Christian
Text: Can only be packed by a Rookie. During any turn when your opponent draws more than 1 card (other than his Draw Segment), you may hide this card and he does not draw those cards; when you have lower Fortitude, you draw that number of cards. When you are Heath Slater, you may hide this card to reverse a non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card.

name: PRO CM Punk
Text: Can only be packed by a Rookie. When you are Darren Young, your Starting Hand Size is +1 and when revealed your opponent discards 1 Backlash card. During your turn, you may hide this card and name a reversal card, and he cannot play the named card to your next card played this turn.

name: PRO Hornswoggle
Text: Can only be packed by a Rookie. During your opponent's turn, when you have 10- cards in Arsenal, you may put this card from your Backstage into your Ring to completely reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver; when you are not Titus O'Neil, discard cards until you have no more than 3 cards in hand. Cannot be moved from your Ring.

name: PRO Matt Hardy
Text: Can only be packed by a Rookie. During your turn when you successfully play a Grapple or High Risk maneuver, you may hide this card and shuffle 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal; when the maneuver was a non-Multi High Risk, shuffle 2 additional cards. When you are Justin Gabriel, you may shuffle in 2 additional cards and draw 2 cards.

name: PRO R-Truth
Text: Can only be packed by a Rookie. During your turn, you may hide this card and when your next card played this turn is maneuver, it is considered Unique; when you are David Otunga, you may also put up to 2 cards from your Ringside under The 'It' Factor.

name: PRO The Miz
Text: Can only be packed by a Rookie. When you successfully play a non-reversal card, you may hide this card and then search your opponent's Arsenal for a card with the same title, he removes it from the game and shuffles. When you would discard cards for his effects, you may instead hide this card and overturn the same number of cards.

name: PRO William Regal
Text: Can only be packed by a Rookie. When you are Skip Sheffield, your Starting Hand Size is +1, and double the numbers in this card. During your turn, you may hide this card and choose one: search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique Action, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; or when your next card played this turn is a Strike or Assault, your opponent must discard 1 card and overturn 2 cards to play a reversal to it.

name: Pure and Wholesome
Text: Cannot be packed by Gail Kim. When your opponent would look at your hand or Backlash, you may flip 1 card in your Ring face-down, and then he does not look and you do not discard or move cards from your hand or Backlash for that effect. You cannot look at his hand. When you would choose cards from his hand, choose twice as many random cards instead.

name: R!
Text: As an action, cannot be reversed when played after O! or when W! and O! are in your Ring; shuffle up to 2 cards removed from the game into your Arsenal. As a reversal, when played from hand, and W! and O! are in your Ring, reverse any non-unique Action card. When successfully played, your opponent discards 2 cards and then search your Arsenal and Ringside for M!, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: R-Truth
Text: Your first maneuver played each turn that is not Chain, Foreign Object, Heat, Multi, Revolution, or Volley is considered Unique. Your Eve: Dirty Dancer is not Fan Favorite. You can pack High-Flying Style, and you can pack Face and Heel cards in your Little Jimmy Deck, but you cannot pack Face or Heel cards (including Superstar-specific cards) in any other Area; you cannot pack There Is No Escape. Your Arsenal can only contain 50 cards, and your Backlash can only contain 8 Pre-match and 8 Mid-match cards.

name: Raven's Rules
Text: After all Pre-matches are resolved and you do not have a Stipulation in your Ring, reveal this card. When packing this card, you are a WCW Superstar, and you may pack up to 3 different Stipulations in your Backstage Area. When revealed, put any number of Stipulations from your Backstage Area into your Ring, and when you overturn a non-hybrid maneuver for your Ability, you may put it in your hand instead. Your Running Bulldog and Drop Toe Hold cards are Chain when played.

name: Raw Roulette Wheel
Text: Your Pre-match Capacity is +1. Reveal 3- different non-'Cell' Backlash Stipulations, play 1 on top of this card (it cannot be blocked) and put the rest under this card. The card on top of this card counts as in your Ring. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1, and then put any Stipulation on top of this card under it and put 1 random Stipulation under this card on top.

name: Really? REALLY?!
Text: Reverse any non-unique non-maneuver card, draw up to 1 card, and put up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, before your Draw Segment you may put it on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Reinforcements from Harris and McGillicutty
Text: Your opponent cannot respond to this card, and it cannot be blanked. When you are New Nexus, this card is F: 0; when you are not, remove Rookie cards in your Backstage Area from the game until there are 3 or less. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may remove 3 random cards in your Ringside from the game and put 1 non-reversal card removed from the game into your hand or Backlash.

name: Reverse Power Slam
Text: Draw up to 1 card or put up to 1 reversal from your Ringside in your hand. When you have at least 5 lower Fortitude, double those numbers.

name: Rewriting Miz-tory
Text: When played, you may flip over 3 of your WWE cards, and then this card may be played regardless of your Fortitude Rating. Search your Arsenal for 2 The Miz-specific maneuvers and 1 non-Superstar-specific card, reveal them, put those cards in your hand, and shuffle. When Skull-Crushing Finale is in your Ringside, you may put it into your Backlash. Flip 1 of your opponent's WWE cards over.

name: Ricardo Interferes
Text: Reverse any maneuver and put up to 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal; when the reversed maneuver was a Trademark Finisher, discard 2 cards. When Ricardo Rodriguez, Personal Ring Announcer is revealed, put up to 1 non-Unique maneuver from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Ricardo Rodriguez, Personal Ring Announcer
Text: Your Pre-match Capacity is +3. Your opponent cannot play 'Your Town'. During your turn, you may hide this card and your next maneuver played this turn is -8F. When you have lower Fortitude, you may hide this card to reverse a non-Unique maneuver and draw up to 1 card.

name: Right Here, In...
Text: When you successfully play a card with 'back here' or 'cheap' in the title, choose 1: your opponent discards 1 card, you draw 1 card, or shuffle up to 1 random card from your Ringside into your Arsenal. When you have 5+ lower Fortitude, double those numbers. Once during each of your turns, you may either overturn 2 cards or discard 2 cards and then you are considered to be 'in Columbus, OH at Origins' for the rest of the turn. When your have 5+ lower Fortitude, your It's Great to be Back Here In... cards also reverse non-Superstar-specific maneuvers.

name: Right Time to Get Crunk!
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Starting Hand Size is +2. Search your Arsenal and Ringside for Eve: Dirty Dancer, put it in your Ring, and shuffle.

name: Rise Above Hate
Text: In Ringside: when you are John Cena and your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may put this card into your Ring and use your Ability as if the maneuver was successful. In Ringside: when you are The Champ and your opponent's maneuver is either reversed from Arsenal or applies D: 4-, you may put this card into your Ring and use your Ability as though their maneuver applied D: 5 and was not reversed from Arsenal.

name: Roar of the Silverback
Text: As an action, put up to 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. As a reversal, this card is F: 0, reverse any non-maneuver card or Activated Card Effect. When successfully played, put up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand. When this card is in your Ring and you successfully play a maneuver, you may put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Rolling Cross Arm Breaker
Text: Your opponent discards his Backlash. When your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text and it cannot be reversed.

name: Rude's Changing Alliances
Text: This deck may only contain Allegiance cards (regardless of other cards packed), but you may not pack Allegiance cards in your Backlash. When you reveal your Superstar card, put 1 card in this deck on top of this card; once during each of your turns, you may put the card on top of this card into this deck, and then put 1 card in this deck on top of this card. The card on top of this card is considered to be in your Ring.

name: Sable's TKO
Text: Choose one: draw up to 2 cards or put 1 card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Santino's Hip Toss
Text: When your Superstar card has a Santino Marella logo, this is also considered an Antic for your card effects, and it can only be reversed by Unexpected Turn of Events. You may put 1 card from your Ringside under Santino's Casa.

name: Santino's Splits
Text: When played from hand, reverse any non-unique maneuver or any hybrid non-Trademark Finisher card. When this card is in your Ring and Beware The COBRA! is revealed, You Sonamagun! now reads: 'When overturned, reverse any maneuver and your opponent overturns 1 card.'

name: Scotty 2 Hotty
Text: During any turn when you successfully play a non-Pre-match card with exactly two words in the title, you may draw 2 cards and then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal. You can pack The Return BASH for Scotty's W-O-R-M as if it is not a BASH card, and it now reads 'Reverse any non-Unique card and draw up to 2 cards.'

name: Scotty's Diving Elbow
Text: When you are Scotty 2 Hotty, this card is Multi and can only be reversed by 2 D: 0 reversals. As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or a Scotty 2 Hotty-specific card; cannot be reversed from Backlash. As an action, shuffle this card and up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw up to 2 cards; you cannot play this card for the rest of the turn as an action.

name: Scotty's Faceplant
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -12F, and when played after a successfully played maneuver, cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash. As a reversal, reverse any Strike or Action. When successfully played, search your Arsenal for 2 Scotty 2 Hotty-specific cards, reveal them, put them in your hand, and shuffle.

name: See How It Feels
Text: Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. Search your opponent's hand, Backlash, Arsenal, Ring and Ringside for 1 Trademark Finisher, reveal it, add that card's Damage, Stun Value and text to this card, ignoring any reversal restrictions, until the end of the turn; he shuffles his Arsenal. This card is -5D and -1 Stun Value until the end of the turn.

name: Seeing Double!
Text: Can only be played when your opponent successfully plays a maneuver. Blank the maneuver's text, overturn cards equal to half the maneuver's printed damage, rounded down; shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and he overturns 2 cards. ACE: When this card is in your Ring, before your Draw Segment, you may put I've Got A Present...Just For You! from your Ring into your Backlash, and remove this card from the game.

name: Series of Body Slams
Text: Cannot be reversed by non-Unique cards from hand or Ringside; when played after a successfully played card, cannot be reversed from Backlash. ACE: During your turn, you may discard 2 cards and overturn 3 cards, and then put this card into your hand.

name: She Looks Good to Me
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your opponent may not search your Arsenal. Replace the 'Can only be played...' text on your cards with 'moonsault' in the title with 'Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver'. When you successfully play a card that lets you search any Arsenal, you may instead reveal 1 of your non-unique cards removed from the game and put it in your hand.

name: Sheamus
Text: Replace the 'game' text with 'turn' on your Pump Kick cards. Maneuvers in your Backstage can be played, regardless of Volley Lock; when they are not Pump Kick, they cannot be reversed by hybrid reversals.

name: Sheamus's Flying Shoulderblock
Text: Can be played from Backstage Area. Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver; when played after Sheamus-specific maneuver or from Backstage Area, cannot be reversed by D:0 reversals. When this card is in your Ringside and your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may discard 2 cards and put this card into your Backstage Area.

name: Sheffield's Running Lariat
Text: When you are Skip Sheffield, this card is -10F and can only be reversed by Unique reversals. When played as a maneuver, this card is -5F and +5D.

name: Shhhhhhh!
Text: Reverse any non-Superstar-Specific non-maneuver card, or any card with Momentum, and your opponent puts the reversed card on the bottom of his Arsenal instead; draw 1 card. When this card is in your Ring and your maneuvers played from hand are unsuccessfully played, you may put them on the bottom of your Arsenal instead.

name: Simply Flawless!
Text: As an action, this card is -4F, search your Arsenal for 1 card, put it in your hand, and shuffle. As a reversal, reverse any card that would cause you to discard cards or remove cards from the game. When successfully played, choose one: put 1 Backlash card from your Ringside into your Backlash, or put up to 3 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Skip Sheffield
