Text: Once during each of your turns, you may remove 1 card in your Ring from the game, and then search the top 5 cards of your Arsenal for 1 maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Skull Crushing Finale
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successfully played card and cannot be reversed from your opponent's hand by non-hybrid Reversals. As a reversal, reverse any card with the Restricted Modification Symbol, and he discards 3 cards.

name: Slammin' and Jammin'
Text: When you have 10+ lower Fortitude and you Activate Perennial Fan Favorites, your opponent cannot reverse the effect; you cannot Activate cards with that title for the rest of the turn. When you do not have a Corner in your Ring, your Superstar-specific cards are now Tag cards. When you have lower Fortitude, ignore the 'completely' text on his reversal cards and effects to your Tag cards.

name: Slater's Rockin' Lariat
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card; when played, ignore 'non-Superstar-specific' on The One-Man Rock Band.

name: Smackdown!'s Executive Consultant
Text: When it is your turn, this card is -15F, search your Arsenal for up to 3 cards, put them into your hand, then shuffle 8 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. When it is not your turn, reverse every other pending card, even if those cards cannot be reversed or have Momentum, and end your opponent's turn.

name: Smacked With the 2x4
Text: As a maneuver, when your 2 x 4 is revealed, this card is now Multi and +4D. As a reversal, reverse any High Risk, overturn 2 cards, and shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Somebody Gon' Get Their Wig Split!
Text: Choose one: shuffle all maneuvers in your Ringside into your Arsenal, or look at your opponent's hand, choose 2 cards, and he discards the chosen cards. When this card is not reversed, it is considered a successfully played maneuver for the rest of this turn.

name: Somebody Gon' Get They A$% Kicked!
Text: Cannot be blanked, and does not take up a slot in your Ring. When packing this card, your Stun the Crowd is Unique. Your maneuvers are +1 Stun Value, and your printed 4D+ maneuvers are +4D.

name: Soviet Power
Text: When you are Nikolai Volkoff, this card is Chain. Put up to 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal and draw up to 2 cards; when you are Nikolai Volkoff, double those numbers. When this card is in your Ring, your maneuvers are +2D.

name: Spinning Faceplant
Text: Draw up to 2 cards. When this card is discarded for your Ability, shuffle it into your Arsenal instead; when it is overturned, put it in your hand instead.

name: Springboard Neck Snap
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D+ maneuver or as a Counter (maneuver). He cannot play non-D: 0 reversals to this card.

name: Stand Up For WWE!
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: WWE. As an action, cannot be reversed when you have lower Fortitude; shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw 1 card. As a reversal, reverse any ECW, nWo, or WCW card.

name: Starship Pain
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 5D+ maneuver. Cannot be reversed from Backlash or Arsenal.

name: Stealing Rock's Catchphrases
Text: This card is considered to be both The Rock-specific and Mankind-specific. As an action, search for any The Rock-specific card, or card with 'The Rock' in the title; reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. As a reversal, this card is -4F, reverse any maneuver; when overturned, this card is F:0 and instead reverse any card or non-damage card effect, and then put this card in your Ring.

name: Sting's Howl
Text: Cannot be reversed when played after a successfully played maneuver. Reveal the top 4 cards of your Arsenal, you may choose any Face, Fan Favorite, or WCW cards and put them into your hand; put the rest on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you did not choose, draw up to 2 cards. When the next card played was one of the revealed cards, ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on it. ACE: During your turn when this card is in your Ring, Ringside, or removed from the game, you may discard 2 cards, and then put it in your Backlash and end your turn.

name: Struck With the Mask
Text: When Cody's Protective Face Mask is revealed, this card is Multi and cannot be reversed by hybrid reversals. When you have lower Fortitude and your opponent has 15 or greater Fortitude, this card is -20F and cannot be reversed by non-Superstar-specific cards from hand or Backlash. He discards 2 random cards. This card cannot be moved from your Ring by your effects.

name: Stump-Puller Piledriver
Text: When you are The Rock and Sock Connection, this card is -5F. Your opponent discards 2 cards. When you reveal this card for The Official Matching Jackets, put 1 non-hybrid maneuver from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Submission Wrestling Specialist
Text: Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique Submission without 'reverse' in the text, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When you would play a printed F: 0 Submission for Panic Grab, you may play a non-unique printed F: 0 maneuver from your hand instead, but you cannot put I Have 'til FIVE! into your Ring this turn.

name: Suffer... Pain... Hurt... You're Through!
Text: When this card is unsuccessfully played, put it in your Backlash instead, and your turn continues; you may not play this card for the rest of the turn. Your Catatonic Stare, My Name Is... and Testify! are F: 0 and cannot be reversed by hybrid or BASH reversals. ACE: During any player's turn, you may remove this card from the game to reverse an effect that would negate a Pinfall victory and end the current turn.

name: Survey Time! Who's Here to See The n...W...o...?
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: nWo. Cannot be blanked. When packed by Hall and Nash or Scott Hall, this card is Superstar-specific. At the end of the Pre-match phase, draw up to 1 card, put up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, your opponent discards 1 card, and overturns 1 card. When you are Scott Hall, double those numbers. ACE: During your turn, you may remove this card from the game and shuffle up to # +2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, where # is the number of nWo cards in your Ring and Backstage Area.

name: Swagger's Ankle Lock
Text: Search your Arsenal and Ringside for Maintain Hold, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When Maintain Hold is your next card played this turn, you may ignore the 'Can only be played...' text.

name: Sweet Shin Music
Text: Can only be packed by Dude Love. When moved from Ringside by your Ability, remove 2 other cards in your Ringside from the game. When successfully played, shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, draw up to 3 cards, and your opponent discards 3 cards. When unsuccessfully played, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead.

name: Sweetness
Text: When played as a maneuver, ignore 'non-Superstar-specific' on The One-Man Rock Band. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple or non-maneuver card. When successfully played, your opponent discards 1 card and 1 random card.

name: Sycho Strength
Text: This card is considered D: 0 for your opponent's effects. Reverse any Strike, Grapple or Submission and put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Talk to the Hand
Text: Can be played from the top of your Arsenal. Reverse any Action or Activated Card Effect, search your Arsenal for 1 card, and put it on top of your Arsenal. ACE: During your turn, you may shuffle and end your turn.

name: Tarver's Face Mask
Text: When you are Michael Tarver, your Starting Hand Size is +3. Your opponent must discard 2 Mid-match cards to reverse your first non-Pre-match non-reversal card played of the game; when you are Michael Tarver, double that number. Before your Draw Segment of the first turn of the game, search your Arsenal, choose 1 card with 'punch' in the title, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle; when you are not Michael Tarver, you may not choose a Unique card.

name: Tarver's Lightning
Text: As a maneuver, cannot be reversed by non-Unique cards when you have lower Fortitude. As a reversal, reverse any Strike or Grapple. Your opponent discards cards equal to the number of cards in your Ring with 'punch' in the title.

name: Tarver's Taped Fists
Text: Your cards with 'jab' and 'uppercut' in the title are considered to have 'punch' in the title for your effects. When your Fortitude Rating is 10 or less, and you have lower Fortitude, your opponent must discard 2 Backlash cards to play a non-Superstar-specific reversal to your cards with 'punch' in the title.

name: Team Bring It!
Text: Cannot be blanked. Can be played during any Pre-match phase, and your opponent cannot prevent you from playing this card. Your Superstar-specific maneuvers and your cards with 'The Rock' in the text are Multi, ignore 'completely' on his reversals and reversal effects to them, and when they are successfully played, draw 1 card. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may reveal up to 2 actions in your hand and put the same number of maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand, and then shuffle the revealed actions into your Arsenal.

name: Team Spirit
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Faction. When you do not have a Revolution card in your Ring, this card is -6F and when it is unsuccessful, put it in your Backlash instead. Search your Arsenal for 1 card with your Faction in the text, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Teardrop Suplex
Text: As an action, this card is -30F, put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and choose one: your opponent discards 1 random card or put 1 High Risk from your Ringside into your hand. As a reversal, reverse any card that allows your opponent to draw cards.

name: Ted DiBiase
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may choose 1 card in your Ringside, remove it from the game, and then shuffle 1 Throwback card from your Ringside into your Arsenal. When you successfully play a Throwback maneuver, draw up to 1 card.

name: Ted's Sit-out Spinebuster
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F. As a reversal, reverse any non-unique non-Throwback maneuver. When successfully played, look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and he discards the chosen card.

name: The 'It' Factor
Text: Cannot be blanked, and cannot be moved from your Ring when there are no cards under this card. Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card from hand under this card. When you must discard any number of cards, you may move cards from under this card to your Ringside instead. When this card is moved from your Ring, put all cards under it into your hand, and shuffle up to the same number of cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: The 'On One' Arena, Ontario, California
Text: ACE: When your opponent reverses any card from Arsenal on the first card, you may put this card into your Ringside, and then discard 2 cards and continue your turn. When played at the Adam Crites Memorial Tournament, do not discard any cards. When this card is in your Ringside and he reverses any card from Arsenal on the first card, you may remove this card from the game, discard 2 cards and continue your turn.

name: The A-List Superstar
Text: As an action, this card is F: 0 and your opponent cannot respond to it when you have lower Fortitude; when your next card played this turn is a maneuver, you may put cards equal to the Damage of that maneuver from under The 'It' Factor into your Ringside; if you do, your opponent cannot respond to that maneuver. As a reversal, reverse a non-Unique maneuver and draw 1 card.

name: The An-Cole Lock
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When played after a Michael Cole-specific card and you have at least 5 printed Michael Cole-specific cards in your Ring, this card is +15D and cannot be reversed.

name: The Barrett Barrage
Text: Before your Draw Segment when this card is in your hand, you may put it in your Ring and draw 1 card. When you unsuccessfully play a maneuver, put up to 1 other maneuver from your Ringside into your hand and end your turn. When you successfully play a maneuver and this card is in your Ring or Ringside, you may put it into your hand.

name: The Best In The World
Logos: JeriShow, CM Punk, Daniel Bryan, Chris Jericho
Text: Cannot be packed by New Nexus. As a reversal, this card is -2F for each different maneuver type in your Ring; when you are CM Punk or Revolution CM Punk, this card is -10F; when played from hand, reverse any maneuver. Your opponent overturns 1 card for each different maneuver type in your Ring; when successfully played as an action, he overturns twice as many cards instead.

name: The Book of Ezekiel
Text: When you are Ezekiel Jackson, this card is -5F. As a reversal, reverse any Strike, Assault, Grapple, or Throw. Your opponent discards 3 cards.

name: The Brogue Kick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is +2D for each Pump Kick in your Ring. As a reversal, reverse any Strike or Grapple. When successfully played, shuffle up to 4 cards in your Ringside and/or removed from the game into your Arsenal.

name: The Celtic Warrior
Text: Your Pre-match Capacity is +2. Once during each of your turns, you may reveal 1 Trademark Finisher in your hand or Ringside, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, and then put 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your Backstage Area. Once during each of your turns, you may remove 3 cards in your Ringside from the game, and put up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your Backstage Area.

name: The Chairman's Judgment
Logos: Vince McMahon, The Genetic Jackhammer, The McMahon Dynasty
Text: When the reversed card is not a Set-up or Follow-up, put it under this card face-up. When your opponent plays an Action or Antic with the same title as the card under this card, it is blank. During his turn, he may overturn 3 cards and discard 1 card, and then you put the card under this card into his Ringside.

name: The Cole Mine
Text: This card is packed as either a Pre-match or a Mid-match. As an event, this card is -7F; until the first turn of the game, no player may move cards from his opponent's hand. As a reversal, reverse any card that would allow him to move any of your cards from one zone to any other zone; choose 1 non-Unique card in his Ring and he removes that card from the game.

name: The Cornfed Meathead
Text: Cannot be blanked. When this card is moved from your Ring, put up to 1 card from Ringside into your hand. When you would overturn cards for The NXT Breakout Star, overturn half as many cards instead, rounded up. When this card is in your Ring or Ringside, your non-Revolution cards with 'lariat' in the title cannot be reversed by Unique cards, and your opponent cannot play non-Unique reversals with 'completely' in the text from hand or use reversal effects with 'completely' in the text to your Lariat Takedown cards.

name: The Corre
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, reveal your top Arsenal cards until 4 maneuvers are revealed; put them in your Backstage and shuffle. Maneuvers in your Backstage are hidden. Once during each of your turns, you may reveal 1 Hand maneuver, Recover it, and Backstage Search 1 maneuver.

name: The Dangerous Slam
Text: When you are Dangerous Alliance and this card is in your Ringside, when your opponent's effects cause you to discard he must then discard the same number of cards you do, and during his turn he may discard 3 cards and then you put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: The Dark Angel's Graceful Escape
Text: Reverse any Unique maneuver, your opponent overturns 3 cards, and your first maneuver played on your next turn is -5F.

name: The Devil's Favorite Demon
Text: During your turn, you may put 1 card with 'hell' in the title from your Ringside under Embrace the Hate, and then play 1 Superstar-specific maneuver from Ringside. When your effect would cause your opponent to discard cards or move cards from his Ring, the number of cards cannot be greater than 4. You may pack Unique non-Revolution Kane Arsenal cards with no other logos, Another Big Freak'n Hellfire Boot, As Big and Tough As Any Two Men, and Born of Hellfire (it is now Permanent). You cannot pack Corners, Managers, Run-ins, or Tonight I Unleash Hell.

name: The DiBiase Trust Fund
Text: Can be played during any Pre-match phase, except the Events phase. Cannot be blanked. Your opponent's 'Your Town' is blank. Put the top 10 cards of your Arsenal under this card. Your cards are -#F, where # is half of the number of cards under this card. When you successfully play a card, put # cards from under this card on the bottom of your Arsenal, where # is twice the amount of printed Damage on that card.

name: The Divas of Doom
Text: Your Mid-match capacity is +1 for each A Phoenix Rising in your Ring. When your opponent's Fortitude Rating is 15+ and your Fortitude Rating is 5-, you may hide this card and then search your Ringside, Arsenal, and cards removed from the game for 1 Superstar-specific maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: The Dudley Family
Text: When you successfully play a maneuver, search your Arsenal and Ringside for a non-Unique Table! Table! Table! card, put it in your Ring, and shuffle. Once during each of your turns, when you Activate Table! Table! Table!, it cannot be reversed. When you successfully play a maneuver modified by that card, your opponent ignores reversal restrictions from Arsenal. Your Strikes, High Risks, and Trademark Finishers are also considered Grapples for your card effects. You may pack Dudley Dog and Unique non-Virtual non-Run-in Arsenal cards that are Dudley Boyz, Buh-Buh Ray Dudley, D-Von Dudley, and/or Spike Dudley cards. You are a Tag Team.

name: The End Of The World As You Know It
Text: This card is considered to have blank text for your effects. When you have at least 15 lower Fortitude, this card is -7F. When this card is in your Ring, your successfully played Superstar-specific maneuvers are considered to have blank text for your effects.

name: The Family Has My Back
Text: Can only be played by a Hart Family member. When played from hand, reverse a non-Unique maneuver; when your opponent is a Stable or can pack Tag Team Title Belts, reverse any maneuver instead. Put up to 1 maneuver from your Ringside into your hand, and he discards 1 card.

name: The Flannel Shirt
Text: Cannot be blanked and your opponent cannot prevent you from playing this card. Cannot be packed when packing Wrestlemania. After all Pre-match cards are played, you may put Origins 2005 from your Backlash into your Ring, and it cannot be blanked; your Cheap Pops Rule! do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Cards with those titles are considered Superstar-specific for his effects. Double the numbers in your cards with 'cheap pop' or 'Socko' in the title, and when you discard a card with 'cheap' in the title, it is considered to be 2 cards for your card effects.

name: The Frankensteiner
Text: When you are the Steiner Brothers, pack this card in your Backstage Area instead of Arsenal. When you are Big Poppa Pump, can be played from Ringside. When played as a Counter, this card is a High Risk instead of a Grapple. Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. When this card is in your Ringside, your maneuvers are -4F.

name: The French Kiss DDT
Text: Can be played from the top of your Arsenal. When played from the top of your Arsenal, this card is +10F. ACE: Once during each of your turns, when your opponent has more than 1 card in his Arsenal you may reveal the top card of his Arsenal; when it does not have the same title as the card that is on top of your Arsenal, he puts that card into his Ringside.

name: The French TKO Kick
Text: As a maneuver, when the top card of your Arsenal is a maneuver, this card is -6F. As a reversal, when the top card of your Arsenal is a reversal, this card is -4F; reverse any non-Unique maneuver.

name: The Genetic Freak
Text: Cannot be packed when packing A Giant Assist. Your Big Poppa Pump-specific Pre-match cards do not take up a Pre-match slot and cannot be blanked. When your maneuver is unsuccessfully played, you may put 1 Belly to Belly Suplex card from your hand into your Ring; when your Fortitude Rating is 4 or less, you may instead search your Arsenal for Belly to Belly Suplex, put it in your Ring, and shuffle.

name: The Good R-Truth or... The Bad R-Truth?
Text: This deck may contain up to 10 Arsenal Face cards, up to 8 Backlash Face cards, up to 10 Arsenal Heel cards, up to 8 Backlash Heel cards. When you reveal your Superstar card, reveal either all Face or all Heel cards in this deck, add those Backlash cards to your Backlash, and shuffle those Arsenal cards into your Arsenal.

name: The Great One
Text: Your first non-Backlash The Rock-specific Action played each turn is F: 0 and cannot be reversed. Your Sharpshooter and Spine Buster maneuvers are F: 0. You may pack Unique non-Virtual non-Pre-match The Rock cards and Shades of the Great One. You cannot pack Corners, Managers, or Run-ins.

name: The Great White
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you have 10+ 4D+ maneuvers in your Ring and/or Backstage Area and you successfully play a maneuver, search your opponent's Arsenal for 1 card, remove it from the game, and he shuffles. ACE: During your turn, you may put all Pump Kick cards in your Ring into your Backstage Area, and then shuffle up to # of your cards removed from the game (except non-hybrid reversals) into your Arsenal, where # is 2 + the number of Pump Kick cards moved from your Ring.

name: The Guru of Greatness
Text: When you have at least 10 lower Fortitude, this card is -10F and your opponent cannot respond to it. Your Human Highlight Reel is Multi and cannot be reversed. Search your Arsenal, Ringside, and cards removed from the game for 1 non-unique maneuver that is either F: 0 or a 10D- High Risk, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When that card is your next card played this turn, you may remove 4 cards in your Ringside from the game and then he cannot respond to it.

name: The Gut Check
Text: Reverse any non-Unique maneuver or when overturned, remove this card from the game to reverse any maneuver or non-damage card effect (even during the Pre-match phase). When this card is overturned for The NXT Breakout Star, you may remove it from the game. When this card is removed from the game, shuffle up to 3 cards (up to 6 if it was overturned for The NXT Breakout Star) from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: The Hardcore Diaries
Text: This card is packed as either a Pre-match or a Mid-match. Can only be packed by Cactus Jack. As an event, this card is F: 0; search your Arsenal for any number of cards with 'hardcore' in the title, reveal them, put them under this card, and shuffle. As an action, search your Arsenal for up to 2 Foreign Objects, reveal them, put them under this card, and shuffle. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may put 1 card from under this card into your hand and then discard 2 cards.

name: The Hart Family
Logos: Bret Hart, Owen Hart, Hart Foundation, British Bulldog, Hart Dynasty, Natalya
Text: Cannot be blanked and your opponent cannot prevent you from playing this card. Cannot be played when you have Allegiance: WWE. You are a Hart Family member and before your first turn of the game, when you do not have a Venue in your Ring, you may put Calgary, Alberta, Canada from your Backlash into your Ring. When this card is in your Ring and you do not have a Corner in your Ring, he must discard 2 cards in order to be able to reverse your non-Backlash Superstar-specific actions from hand or Backlash.

name: The High Cross
Text: When played after a Strike or Assault, cannot be reversed from Backlash. When played after a Grapple or Throw, cannot be reversed from hand. When played after a card that was played from your Backstage Area, cannot be reversed from Ring or Ringside.

name: The Hip-Hop Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 2D+ maneuver; when that maneuver was Superstar-specific, this card cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may put it at the bottom of your Arsenal and put up to 1 hybrid Action card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: The Hip-Hop Goggles
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 card and your opponent reveals 2 random cards in his hand. When any revealed card has exactly two words in the title, draw 1 card. During any turn, you may hide this card and he plays with his hand revealed for the rest of the turn.

name: The Hulkster: American Made
Text: Can only be packed by Hollywood Hulk Hogan, when you are not packing nWo World Title Belt. You are a WCW Superstar, your cards with 'American' in the title do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your Activated Card Effects from Superstar-specific Pre-match cards cannot be reversed.

name: The Iceman
Text: When packing this card, you may pack The Radicalz-specific cards with 'radical' in the title. During your turn when you do not have cards with 'psychology' in the title in your Ring, you may hide this card and your Ability is now blank. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put Walking Out of WCW from your Backlash into your Ring. When The Iceman Cometh would remove your card from the game, you may overturn 2 cards and put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead (or when the card is a Backlash card, in your Ringside instead).

name: The Irish Curse
Text: When played from Backstage Area, cannot be reversed from Backlash. When this card is in your Ring, during your opponent's turn he must discard 1 card to play a Unique card.

name: The Irish Hammer
Text: When played from Backstage Area, this card is +7F, +7D, and cannot be reversed from hand by non-Superstar-Specific cards.

name: The Jersey Triad
Text: This card is considered non-Unique for your card effects. Put this card, up to 1 card from your Ringside, and up to 1 non-reversal card removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal. Your opponent overturns 1 card. Your next card played this turn is +1 Stun Value.

name: The Kill Shot Punch
Text: When played, this card is -15F, and when your opponent's Fortitude Rating is 20 or more, this card is a Trademark Finisher instead of a Strike. When this card is overturned for The NXT Breakout Star, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead.

name: The King of Bling Bling
Text: When played after a Unique card, this card is -8F. Put up to # of your cards removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal, where # is the number of Unique cards in your Ring and cannot be greater than 10. When you discard this card for your Superstar-specific card effects, it is considered to be 3 cards.

name: The King of Kings
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 3 cards, shuffle 1 card from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and then search for 1 Triple H-specific maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When played as a Counter, you may ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on Leaping Knee to the Face. You may pack Unique Triple H Arsenal cards with no additional logos and without 'interfere' in the title, and Sledge Hammer Shot (it is not Heel). You cannot pack Corners, Managers, or Run-ins. You are a Legend.

name: The Last Dangerous Ride
Text: As a maneuver, this card is not affected by The Most Dangerous Champions of SmackDown!. As an action, this card is F:0, draw up to 1 card, then shuffle this card into your Arsenal.

name: The Last Outlaw
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put Wrestlemania from your Backlash into the Ring, and when you have lower Fortitude and Activate that card, your opponent cannot reverse it. When Wrestlemania is in your Ringside, once during each of your turns, you may play 1 of your non-Superstar-specific cards removed from the game as if played from hand. You may pack Classic Competitor, and either Unique Arsenal Undertaker cards or Unique Arsenal Deadman Inc. cards. You cannot pack Corners, Managers, Run-ins, or Title Belts. Your Living Legend is not Face.

name: The Lay-Out
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F and +5D. As a reversal, reverse any non-Superstar-specific Grapple or any Action. When successfully played, your opponent discards 1 random Backlash card.

name: The Lie Detector
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played 4D+ Unique maneuver. Can only be reversed from hand or Arsenal. Double the numbers in your WHAT'S UP?! and your opponent chooses 1 additional choice for Messin' With Little Jimmy.

name: The Little Jimmy
Text: As a maneuver, when you have a Face card in your Ring, this card is -10F. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card; when you have a Heel card in your Ring, this card is -10F.

name: The Mexican Aristocrat
Text: Draw 1 card for every 2 Alberto Del Rio-Specific cards in your Ring. Look at your opponent's Backlash, choose 1 card, and he discards the chosen card.

name: The Michael Cole Challenge
Text: Search your Arsenal for 3 cards, put them under this card, and shuffle. Once during each of your turns, when your opponent has at least 1 card in hand, you may discard 1 card and choose 1 card under this card; he chooses 1 random card from his hand and both cards are revealed. When the Fortitude of your card is lower, put that card into your hand and shuffle up to 3 cards removed from the game into your Arsenal; when it is not, put your revealed card on the bottom of your Arsenal. Before your Draw Segment, there are no cards under this card, you may hide this card and draw 2 cards.

name: The Million Dollar Couple
Text: Search your Arsenal for Take It Back, put it in your Ring, and shuffle; that card cannot be blanked. During any turn, you may hide this card and remove either 1 card in your Ring or the top card of your Arsenal from the game, and then your next card played this turn is -#F, where # is 3 times the damage of the removed card.

name: The Million Dollar Title Belt
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may search your Arsenal for 1 Throwback card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When you successfully play a Throwback maneuver, your opponent randomly reveals # cards from hand, where # is the number of Throwback cards in your Ring. Superstar Value +1

name: The Miz
Text: When you unsuccessfully play a maneuver, you may discard 2 cards and search your Arsenal for a non-unique maneuver of the same type, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle. During your turn when you successfully play a card, you may discard 2 cards and then search your opponent's Arsenal for a card with the same title, he removes it from the game and shuffles. You may pack cards with 'trash talk' in the text or title as if they are not Face, Heel, or Raw.

name: The Moolah Whip
Text: When played, this card is +#D, where # is the number of your opponent's cards removed from the game. Discard 2 Backlash cards, shuffle up to 8 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and draw 4 cards.

name: The More You Try to Silence Me...
Text: This card is -#F, where # is the number of reversals in your opponent's Ring and cannot be less than 4; when it is reversed, put it in your hand instead. He may remove # random cards in his Ringside from the game. If he does, draw 4 cards and put 4 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal. If he does not, put 4 cards from Ringside and/or removed from the game in your hand and when the next card you play is a The Corre-specific maneuver, it is -4F, +4D, and he cannot respond to it.

name: The Most Decorated Tag Team in History
Text: Your maneuvers are +3D. When your maneuver is unsuccessful and you have at least 8 lower Fortitude, you may search your Arsenal and Ringside for Table, put it into your Ring, and shuffle. During your turn, you may hide this card and discard 3 cards, then search his Arsenal for 3 cards, and he removes them from the game.

name: The Most Must-See WWE Champion
Text: Reveal any number of cards from your hand, and then put up to # cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, where # is the number of revealed cards +3. When you have a Title Belt with 'WWE' in the title in your Ring, you may then shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: The Muscle and The Hustle
Text: When you are Skip Sheffield, this card is +10F and +10D. As a reversal, reverse any non-maneuver card and shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. When this card is overturned, you may put this card into your Ring. When this card is in your Ring, do not discard Backlash cards from successfully played maneuvers.

name: The Muscle of New Nexus
Text: Reverse any non-Unique card, search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. Your opponent overturns 3 cards.

name: The New Legends of the WWE
Logos: The Great One, The Last Outlaw, Texas Rattlesnake, King of Kings, The Showstopper, Mick Foley, The Second Coming, Devil's Favorite Demon
Text: When packing this card, you may pack No Sell Maneuver, and your Superstar-specific cards can be packed as if they are not Raw or Smackdown. During your turn you may hide this card and shuffle 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: The Nexus
Text: Before each of your Draw Segments, hide 1 other Superstar card and choose 1 Superstar Card to reveal. Revealed Superstar Cards add their Ability to this Ability. When your opponent successfully plays a Superstar-specific 8D+ maneuver, or an 8D+ reversal, remove 1 other hidden Superstar Card from the game. You may pack Wade Barrett, Justin Gabriel, David Otunga, Skip Sheffield, Heath Slater, Michael Tarver, and Darren Young in your Backstage Area and they are hidden. You may not pack Corners, Managers, Guest Ringside Announcers, or Face cards.

name: The Nexus Armband
Text: This card is always considered to be revealed. Can only be packed by a Rookie, The Nexus or New Nexus. Packed: cannot pack non-Trait Allegiances or a Pro. Your opponent's Backstage Shenanigans is blocked. Your 'Interfere' cards are -3F, and when successful they discard 1.

name: The Nexus Swarm
Text: Cannot be blanked. During each of your turns when you have not played any cards this turn, and it is not the first turn of the game, when you play a non-Multi printed F: 0 Strike from hand, you may also play another non-Multi printed F: 0 Strike from hand with it; unless both cards are reversed when played, both are successfully played. Unless both cards are reversed, your turn continues.

name: The NXT Breakout Star
Text: Can only be packed by an NXT Superstar. This card is considered Superstar-specific. Do not discard for Armageddon Is Upon Us. Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 4 cards and then draw 1 card; when you have lower Fortitude, overturn 2 less cards.

name: The Official Matching Jackets
Text: Your Superstar-specific reversals count as 2 reversal cards, and replace 'Action' with 'non-maneuver card' on your This Is The Rock's Show. When you have at least 5 lower Fortitude is in your Ring and you use your Ability, you choose both options and your opponent overturns 2 cards. Once during each of your turns, you may reveal 1 Trademark Finisher in your hand and up to 1 non-reversal card in your Ringside, and then draw 1 card and put the revealed cards on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: The One-Man Rock Band
Text: After all Pre-matches are resolved, look at the top 5 cards of your Arsenal, put 1 of those cards in your hand, and put the rest on the top and/or bottom of your Arsenal in any order. When you successfully play an antic or a non-multi action, and your next card played this turn is a non-Superstar-specific maneuver, it can only be reversed by D:0 reversals from hand and Arsenal.

name: The Original Horseman
Text: Your Starting Hand Size, Superstar Value, and Pre-match Capacity are +1 for each WCW and non-Faction The Nature Boy-specific non-Faction Pre-match card in your Ring. Once during each of your turns, you may either overturn 2 cards, and you are considered to be Ric Flair for the rest of the turn; or you may overturn 4 cards, and you are considered to be The Four Horsemen for the rest of the turn.

name: The Original Wrestling Stable
Text: You are a WCW Superstar, and your The Numbers Game cannot be blanked. Your opponent must overturn 4 cards to play a Run-in, Manager, or a card with 'interfere' or 'assist' in the title. During your turn, you may hide this card and then draw up to 4 cards and shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: The Palace of Wisdom
Text: Can be played during the Venue phase. This card does not take a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your Superstar Value is considered to be both lower and higher than your opponent's for your card effects. ACE: During your turn, you may remove this card from the game and put 1 of your cards removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: The People's Elbow
Text: Can only be played as a Counter or when a Trademark Finisher is in your Ring. When you reveal this card for The Official Matching Jackets, your next Superstar-specific card played this turn is -5F and cannot be reversed by non-Unique reversals from hand.

name: The Perfect Neck Snap
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. When played, you may reveal up to 2 Trademark Finishers from hand, and then put the revealed cards on the bottom of your Arsenal. If you revealed 1 Trademark Finisher, this card cannot be reversed from Backlash; if you revealed 2, it also cannot be reversed from hand by non-Superstar-specific cards.

name: The Redemption of Darren Young
Text: When your Fortitude Rating is 5 or less and your maneuver is unsuccessfully played, you may put this card from your Backlash into your opponent's Ring. When this card is in your Ring, you cannot play reversals from hand unless you discard 1 Backlash reversal card; when you are Darren Young, discard any Backlash card instead. When this card is in your Ring and your opponent reverses a card from hand, put this card into his Ring.

name: The Rock and Sock Connection
Text: When one of your maneuvers or Superstar-specific actions is unsuccessfully played, draw 1 card or put 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. Your Layin' the Smacketh Down is not Smackdown, and it is considered Superstar-specific. You may pack non-Unique Arsenal The Rock cards (they are not Cheater) and Rock Bottom. You cannot pack any Corners or Title Belts except the Tag Team Title Belts.

name: The Rough Ryder
Text: Can only be played when you have not Activated a card this turn. As a reversal, this card is -10D, reverse any Grapple or Activated Card Effect.

name: The Samoan Bulldozer
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you have no Revolution cards in your Ring, this card is F: 0, your opponent cannot respond to it, and it is considered to be a Storyline in your Ring for card effects. Your maneuvers are +1D, and he cannot respond to your Umaga-specific Actions. ACE: When your maneuver is unsuccessfully played, you may overturn 3 cards and put it in your hand instead; when you are Umaga and you have lower Fortitude, this effect cannot be reversed.

name: The Second Coming
Text: Legend Superstar Ability: Your Feud cards are now Active Events and can be played during the Feud phase. Once during each of your turns, you may play 1 Ringside card as if from hand (or Backlash if applicable); if it is unsuccessful, put 1 Ringside printed Feud into your Ring, and resolve its text as though it were just played, ignoring ‘At the end of the Pre-match phase’. You can pack Unique Chris Jericho Arsenal and Mid-match cards, and I'm Better Than You.  You cannot pack Corners, Managers, Run-ins, Back to Basics or First Of All.

name: The Shaman of Sexy
Text: As an action, this card is -6F, shuffle this card into your Arsenal and draw 1 card; when your opponent is a Female superstar, he discards 1 random card. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique maneuver or when overturned (even during the Pre-match phase) reverse any non-damage card effect as if this card is F: 0. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and he may draw 1 card.

name: The Showoff
Text: Once during each of your turns when you play a maneuver, you may reveal up to 3 cards in your hand; if you do, that maneuver is +2D and +1 Stun Value, and when it is successfully played, your opponent reveals the same number of random cards in his hand +1. When your maneuver is unsuccessfully played, discard 1 card and overturn 1 card.

name: The Showstopper
Text: Search your Arsenal for The Legend Lives On, put it into your Ring, and shuffle; that card is Permanent and cannot be blanked. Your Heat cards are not removed from Ringside when you move cards from your Ringside with Superstar-specific cards. You can pack non-Storyline non-Virtual Unique Shawn Michaels cards with no other logos. You cannot pack Corners, Managers, Run-ins, Pre-match D: 1+ cards, Foreign Object maneuvers, or A Quick BASH-ing.

name: The South African Sensation
Text: Once during each of your turns when you successfully play a 3D+ maneuver, you may search your Arsenal for 1 High Risk maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when your next card played this turn is a High Risk you may ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text, and your opponent may ignore its 'Can only be reversed...' text. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may reveal 1 High Risk from your hand, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal and then shuffle 1 non-unique non-reversal card from your Ring into your Arsenal.

name: The South Beach Party Boy
Text: When your opponent's next Pre-match card played does not have 'taunt' in the title, he must discard 2 Pre-match cards to play it. Before the Draw Segment of your first turn of the game, search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: The Texas Rattlesnake
Text: Once during each of your turns you may allow all players to draw 1 card, and then all opponents discard 1 card (when you have fewer cards in hand, 2 cards). When you reverse a card to end his turn, he cannot continue his turn. You can pack Unique Stone Cold Steve Austin-specific Arsenal cards and And That's the Bottom Line... You cannot pack Corners, Managers, or Run-ins. Your Chain cards are not Chain.

name: The Torres Wheel
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: The Truth Hurts
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver, and remove up to 2 cards in your opponent's Ringside from the game.

name: The Two-Time Two-Time All-American American American
Text: This card is -10F when The All-American American is in your Ring. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside and your next maneuver played this turn is -5F, Chain, and Multi. When you would put this card into your Backlash with The All-American American, put it into your Ring instead and draw up to 2 cards.

name: The Voice of the Voiceless
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your CM Punk-specific cards do not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring. Your opponent cannot Activate cards or play non-Superstar-specific reversals of D:3+ in response to your maneuvers with 'shoot' in the title. When you successfully play a maneuver with 'shoot' in the title, draw 1 card. When you have at least 5 lower Fortitude and your maneuver with 'shoot' in the title is unsuccessfully played, you may put I'm Straight-Edge from your Backlash into your Ring.

name: The Voice of The WWE
Text: Your Superstar Value is +#, where # is equal to your opponent's Superstar Value. At the end of the Pre-match phase, search your Arsenal for 1 Action, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. After all Pre-match Phases, when you have equal Superstar Value, you begin the game.

name: The Wasteland
Text: When you have either 7 or more cards with The Nexus logo, or both the cards titled From NXT Winner to Nexus Leader and Barrett's Big Boot in your Ring, this card cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash. You may discard up to 5 cards, and your opponent overturns the same number of cards.

name: The World's Strongest Bear Hug
Text: When you would draw for Stun Value from this card, you may instead remove 1 random card in your hand from the game and then put 1 card in your opponent's Ring into his Ringside. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple or Submission.

name: The World's Strongest Man
Text: Search your Arsenal for 1 non-unique 12D+ maneuver, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle. Your opponent cannot reverse your maneuvers from Backlash, Ring, or Ringside.

name: The World's Strongest Slam
Text: Your opponent discards his Backlash. When you would draw for Stun Value from this card, you may instead have your opponent overturn 4 cards.

name: The World's Strongest Splash
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or as a Counter; when the maneuver or reversal is Superstar-specific, this card is a Trademark Finisher instead. When you would draw for Stun Value from this card, you may instead put 1 Mid-match card from your Ring into your Backlash.

name: The World's Strongest Toss
Text: When played after Throw into the Corner Turnbuckle, can only be reversed from Arsenal. Your opponent discards 2 cards. When you would draw for Stun Value from this card, you may instead have him discard 2 cards.

name: The WORM!
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When you have the cards W!, O!, R! and M! in your Ring and you successfully play this card, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: The YES! Lock
Text: You may search your Arsenal for Maintain Hold, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. When this card is reversed from Arsenal, your opponent's reversal is removed from the game instead, and you may put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal. During your turn when this card is in your hand, you may reveal it, and then overturn 1 card, draw 1 card, and put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: The Zack Attack
Text: This card is +1D for each card with an Activated Card Effect in your Ring. Your opponent discards 3 cards. When this card is overturned for your Ability, put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead.

name: The Zig-Zag
Text: As a reversal, reverse any card that would move cards from your Ring or Ringside.

name: This Is Vintage...
Text: When your next card played this turn is Superstar-specific, it cannot be reversed. ACE: When your opponent plays a Superstar-specific non-Trademark non-Trademark Finisher maneuver, you may put this card from your Ring into your hand, and then his card is blank and D: 7 for the rest of the turn.

name: This Is Your Life
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you have at least 5 lower Fortitude, your Superstar-specific maneuvers are Multi and can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. Your Patented Rock Footstomp is now a High Risk, F: 0, +3D, and double the numbers in its text. Replace the 'or The People's Champ' text with 'and Sock Connection' and ignore the 'with the Smackdown logo' text on your Layin' the Smacketh Down.

name: Throwing Their Weight Around
Text: You may increase your Starting Hand Size by 2. Ignore 'completely' on your opponent's reversals to The Biggest Tag Team Champions in WWF History and when that card is reversed, put it into your Backlash instead, regardless of other effects. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, your Fortitude Rating is +4F when playing cards with 'splash' in the title.

name: Time for a Change!
Text: Can only be played by a Hart Family member. This card is -#F, where # is your opponent's Fortitude Rating. When you have lower Fortitude or when played as a Counter, this card cannot be reversed. Overturn up to 3 cards, and shuffle the same number of maneuvers from your Ringside into your Arsenal; draw up to 5 cards, then shuffle the same number of cards from your hand into your Arsenal.

name: Time to Find Out Who I Am
Text: *Can only be revealed during any turn when you successfully play an Evolution-specific card. When packing this card, you are a Stable. Before your Draw Segment, you may hide this card. When this card is revealed, your Ability is blank. When this card is hidden or revealed, your non-F:0 Evolution-specific actions are Multi, and the number of cards removed from the game by Yesterday is So Long Ago is reduced to 0.

name: Too Cool
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards and search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique maneuver with exactly two words in the title, reveal it, put it into your hand, and shuffle. You can pack The Return BASH for Scotty's W-O-R-M as if it is not a BASH card, and when you search your Arsenal with that card, you may instead search for a non-Unique non-hybrid maneuver. You can pack non-Backstage Scotty 2 Hotty cards, but you cannot pack any Title Belts except the Tag Team Title Belts.

name: Too Much Wastin' Time
Text: Can only be played when your opponent successfully Activates a card or successfully plays a non-maneuver card; when this card is in your Ring, his card is blank and Permanent. After damage is resolved, end his turn. When your first card played on your next turn is a John Morrison-specific card, ignore the 'Can only be played after...' text.

name: Touch of Darkness, Flight of Angels
Text: Once during each of your turns when you successfully play a non-High-Risk 3D+ maneuver, you may overturn 2 cards and then reduce the Damage to 0; if you do, the card is considered to be resolved, and your opponent may not play reversals to it.

name: Tough Enough
Logos: Texas Rattlesnake, Trish Stratus, Booker T
Text: Reverse any non-Unique hybrid maneuver, or when you are The Texas Rattlesnake or Trish Stratus, reverse any maneuver; put the reversed maneuver under this card. When this card is in your Ring, during your opponent's turn before his Draw Segment, he may randomly discard 2 cards and then put the card under this card on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Tough Enough Head Trainer
Text: When you play a Superstar-specific card as a Counter (to a maneuver), you may ignore the 'Can only be played...' text. Your opponent must discard 1 card to reverse your Superstar-specific cards from hand or Backlash. When he plays a card that moves cards in your Ring, you may remove 1 card in your hand from the game and the number of cards moved is reduced to 0.

name: Trained in The Hart Family Dungeon
Text: Can only be played by a Hart Family member or Chris Benoit. When you have The Hart Family in your Ring, this card is -15F and your opponent cannot respond to this card. Your maneuvers are -2F. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 2 cards and then put 1 non-Unique non-hybrid maneuver from your Ringside into your hand; when you have lower Fortitude, this effect cannot be reversed.

name: Treat Me For Who I Am
Text: When packing this card, you may pack 3 additional Pre-match and Mid-match cards with 'dynamic' in the text. When your Chyna's Running Lariat is F:0 and played from Ringside, your opponent cannot respond to it. When your opponent would move a Chyna-specific maneuver from your Ringside, you may choose another card in your Ringside instead.

name: Tribal Trouble
Text: When you are Umaga, your Samoan Drop is Chain, when you successfully play that card, put up to 3 cards from Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, and when you do not have a card with that title in your Ring, it is also 'Reversal: non-unique maneuver or Clutch Onto Opponent'. During your turn, you may hide this card and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-Unique non-hybrid maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Trish's Thesz Press
Text: Can only be packed by Trish Stratus. Reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver and then choose any number of cards in your opponent's Ringside, and he puts those cards on the bottom of his Arsenal. ACE: When he plays a non-Unique maneuver, you may put The MaTrish Move from your hand into your Ring to reverse it.

name: Truth or Consequences
Text: This card is -#F, where # is the number of Face cards in your Ring. Your opponent discards 1 card for every 2 Heel cards in your Ring. Put up to 3 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Truth's Water Bottle
Text: Draw up to 2 cards. When you have a Face card in your Ring, shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. When you have a Heel card in your Ring, your opponent discards 2 random cards and overturns 2 cards.

name: Turn It Up!
Text: Once during each of your opponent╞s turns when he successfully plays a card, you may turn 1 2D+ card in your Ring face-down, and his card is -2D. Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 2 cards and turn 1 card in your Ring face-up, then put up to 1 card that is either Scotty 2 Hotty-specific or has exactly two words in the title from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Turn the Tables!
Text: Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put 1 Stipulation from your Backlash into your Ring and when you are The Dudley Family, search your Arsenal for 1 maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. Your Table! Table! Table! action cards are Multi, cannot be reversed by hybrid reversals, and ignore 'completely' on your opponent's reversals and effects to them.

name: Turning Everything Upside Down
Text: As an action, when you have lower Fortitude, your opponent cannot respond to this card; reveal your top 3 Arsenal cards, you may put any D: 3- cards into your Ring face-down, and shuffle. As a reversal, F: 0; when you have lower Fortitude, reverse any card that is not the first or second card played this turn. In Ring: once during each of your turns, you may Flip 1 face-down Ring card without 'win the game' in the printed text.

name: Twin Magic
Text: When played from hand, reverse any maneuver, overturn 2 cards and shuffle 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, put up to 4 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal, and draw the same number of cards.

name: Typhoon's Big Slam
Text: Cannot be reversed by D:1+ non-Unique cards from hand or Backlash. As a maneuver, you may discard 2 cards and search your Arsenal for 1 card with 'splash' or 'tremors' in the title, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle. As a reversal, -2D, reverse any Strike, High Risk, Assault, or Extreme.

name: Uncovering the Conspiracy
Text: Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. You may look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, he removes that card from the game; when you did not, look at all face-down cards in his Ring (including cards under other cards in his Ring) and turn any number of them face-up in the same area.

name: Vickie Guerrero
Text: Once during each of your opponent's turns, when he plays a non-maneuver card, you may immediately play an action card from hand and he may respond to it as if it was your turn. His responses to that card do not end his turn, and you may not respond again to the card that you interrupted. He cannot play cards with 'Vickie' in the title. You may pack Master Manipulator, and you may pack Enforcers in your Backstage Area; when you reveal your Superstar card, reveal 1 Enforcer card and choose 1 Enforcer. You may not pack ECW or nWo cards.

name: Vickie Guerrero Interferes
Logos: Lay-Cool, Dolph Ziggler, Chavo Guerrero, Jack Swagger, Leader of the Edge Army, Vickie Guerrero
Text: When you are Dolph Ziggler, this card is -10F. When you have a card with 'Vickie' in the title in your Ring, reverse any Unique non-maneuver card, and your opponent overturns 2 cards; when Backed by Smackdown GM Vickie Guerrero is in your Ring, draw 1 card and he overturns 2 additional cards.

name: Vickie's Scream
Text: You may use your Ability again this turn. Your next card played this turn cannot be reversed. Your opponent discards 2 random cards.

name: Vickie's Slap
Text: When it is your turn, cannot be reversed by non-hybrid reversals. When it is not, your opponent discards 1 card. Draw 1 card.

name: Vocare Ad Regnum
Text: Cannot be blanked. Before your Draw Segment, when this card is in your Ring, Ringside or removed from the game, you may put it in your Ring, Ringside, or remove it from the game. When this card is in your Ringside, replace 'maneuver' with 'action' in your Ability. When this card is removed from the game and you use your Ability, draw 2 cards instead of searching.

name: W!
Text: Cannot be reversed when played after a Superstar-specific card, or when you reversed with Scotty's Faceplant to end the previous turn. Draw up to 2 cards and shuffle up to 2 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, then search your Arsenal for O!, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: Wade Barrett
Text: Your Strikes without 'kick' in the title that are not hybrid, Multi, or Foreign Objects are -3F and Chain.

name: We Are One
Text: You may put Handicap Match from your Backlash into your Ring. During your turn, you may hide this card and then search your Arsenal for a The Nexus-specific card, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle.

name: We Burn It to the Ground Tonight
Text: Cannot be packed when packing more than 1 copy of The King Interferes! or From the Mind of Eric Bischoff. Can be played regardless of The Boogeyman's Ability. Ignore the 'You cannot play Pre-match cards' text on your Raw Pre-match cards, and your first non-Unique Raw Action of each turn cannot be reversed by hybrid or Unique reversals. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may put 2 Raw cards in your Ring under this card, and then your opponent overturns 2 cards.

name: Welcome to Monday Nitro!
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: WCW. When you are a WCW Superstar, this card does not take up a Pre-match slot in your Ring, and when you Activate Where the Big Boys Play, you may put the cards on the bottom of your Arsenal instead. When Houston, Texas is not in your Ring, you and your opponent draw 4 cards, and he randomly discards cards until he discards a hybrid card; then, you discard the same number of cards. When Flanked by Arena Security is not in any player's Ring, all players' Starting Hand Size are -2, and all players draw 3 less cards for The Best Laid Plans.

name: WHAT'S UP?!
Text: When this card is unsuccessfully played, put it in your Backlash instead. Can only be played after a successfully played card. Can only be reversed by Superstar-specific or Unique cards. Put this card in your Backlash, draw 2 cards and your opponent discards 1 card. You cannot play WHAT'S UP?! for the rest of the turn.

name: When Things Go A-Ry
Text: Reverse any maneuver, and when the reversed maneuver is a Trademark or Trademark Finisher, discard 2 cards and overturn 2 cards.

name: Wild and Young
Text: Reverse any non-Unique maneuver or when overturned, remove this card from the game to reverse any maneuver or non-damage card effect (even during the Pre-match phase). When this card is overturned for The NXT Breakout Star, you may remove it from the game. When this card is removed from the game, shuffle up to 3 cards (up to 6 if it was overturned for The NXT Breakout Star) from your ringside into your arsenal.

name: Winds of Change
Text: As an action, this card is -20F, shuffle this card and any number of cards in your hand into your Arsenal and draw the same number cards; your opponent shuffles # cards from hand into his Arsenal and draws # -1 cards, where # is the number of cards you drew.

name: Woo Woo Woo! You Know It!
Text: This card requires 3 reversals to reverse instead of 2. Shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and your opponent overturns # cards, where # is the number of cards with Activated Card Effects in your Ring and Ringside, and cannot be greater than 9. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside or removed from the game, discard 1 card with an Activated Card Effect or overturn 3 cards, and then put this card into your Backlash and end your turn.

name: World Champion Athleticism
Text: Cannot be blanked. Cannot be packed when packing Stipulations. New Ability: At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may play Do YOU Live by the Three I's?, Intensity, Integrity, and Intelligence regardless of Fortitude. Ignore the 'Can only be played...' text on your Kurt Angle-specific maneuvers, and your Just Hold On a Second, Mister! is now an Event instead. Your Chain cards are not Chain, and your Angle's German Suplex cannot be reversed by D: 1+ reversals.

name: Yep Yep Yep! What It Do
Text: Reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver and put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand.

name: YES! YES! YES!
Text: When you successfully play a maneuver and you have 3 or more non-Revolution maneuver types in your Ring, you may reveal this card, draw 3 cards and your opponent overturns 3 cards. When you have a Title Belt with Superstar Value +3 or greater in your Ring, once during each of your turns you may overturn 3 cards and remove 5 cards in your hand from the game, and then put 1 Daniel Bryan-specific maneuver from your Ring into your hand.

name: Yokozuna's Classic Lariat
Text: When played as a Counter or after BANZAI!, or when this card is affected by a Pre-match Activated Card Effect, cannot be reversed from hand by non-Unique reversals. Choose 1: Draw 2 cards or your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: You Can Look, But You Can't Touch
Text: Reveal your hand and draw up to 2 cards. When your hand is revealed or your opponent looks at your hand, you may put this card from your hand into your Ring, and the number of cards he chooses is reduced to 0.

name: You Don't Throw Rocks at a Man With a Machine Gun!
Logos: Rowdy Roddy Piper, The Rowdy One
Text: Reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card; your opponent discards 1 random card and overturns # cards, where # is the Fortitude of the discarded card (up to 5). When he did not overturn any cards, put up to 1 non-Superstar-specific non-Unique D:0 card from his Ring into his Ringside.

name: You Gonna Get GOT!
Text: Can only be reversed by Superstar-specific or Unique cards. When reversed, draw up to 3 cards. Look at your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and he puts the chosen card and 1 other card on the bottom of his Arsenal. When you have lower Fortitude, he chooses 2 options when you Activate Messin' With Little Jimmy.

name: You Look Fly Today
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Corners. Cannot be blanked. Your Pre-match Capacity is +2, and your Starting Hand Size is +2. When you are Scotty 2 Hotty and your non-Chain maneuver with exactly two words in the title is unsuccessful, your opponent puts 2 cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. When you would discard cards for Armageddon Is Upon Us, discard 2 cards instead.

name: You Love Us!
Text: Draw 1 card and then shuffle up to 8 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. When unsuccessfully played, draw 1 card.

name: You Will Be The People's Partner
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Pre-match Capacity is +2, and your Superstar-specific actions are -10F. Search your Arsenal for 1 The Rock-specific non-reversal card and 1 Mankind-specific non-reversal card, reveal them, put them under this card, and shuffle; during your turn you may put them under this card into your hand. ACE: When there are no cards under this card, you may put this card into your Ringside and then put 2 cards from your Ringside into your hand; when you have at least 5 lower Fortitude, this effect cannot be reversed.

name: You're Either Nexus or You're Against Us
Text: Can be packed when packing The Nexus Armband. When you are The Nexus, this card is F: 0. Reverse any non-Unique maneuver, any Run-in, or any Activated Card Effect from a Manager or Guest Ringside Announcer card. Your opponent discards 1 card and overturns 2 cards; when you are The Nexus, double those numbers.

name: You're Not Enough For Me
Text: Cannot be blanked. When played, this card is considered Smackdown. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 7D- maneuver and then search your Arsenal for 1 non-hybrid 8D+ maneuver, reveal it, put it in your hand, and shuffle; when you do not have a Corner or a card with 'Vickie' in the title in your Ring, you do not discard for your opponent's reversals to this effect.

name: You're Only Smoke and Mirrors
Text: This card ignores modifications from other cards. Completely reverse any card that has been modified by other cards or any card with Momentum. Shuffle up to 5 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: You're the Ugly Ones!
Text: As an action, this card is -8F, overturn 2 cards and put up to 2 cards from Ringside into your hand. As a reversal, reverse any card. When Paper Bag is in any player's Ring, draw 1 card.

name: Your Ignorance is Your Undoing
Text: As an action, discard this card, put 1 other card from Ringside and 1 printed Heat card removed from the game on the bottom of your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Heat card or any card with 'heat' in the title or text; when Managed by Daivari is not in your ring, instead reverse any Unique card. When this card is removed from the game, you may remove 3 Heat cards in your Ringside from the game and then put this card in your Ringside.

name: Youthful Agility
Text: Can only be packed by an NXT Superstar. When you are Justin Gabriel or Michael Tarver, this card is F: 0. As an action, shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any Strike, Grapple, or Submission and draw up to 1 card.

name: Z! True Long Island Story
Text: This card is packed as either a Pre-match or a Mid-match. When this card would go to your Ringside, put it into your Backlash instead. As an event, your Pre-match cards with an Activated Card Effect do not take up Pre-match slots in your Ring. As a reversal, reverse any Activated Card Effect or any non-F:0 non-maneuver card. ACE: During your turn, you may remove 3 cards in your Ringside with an Activated Card Effect from the game and then draw up to 3 cards.

name: Zack Ryder
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 3 cards and your opponent cannot play reversals to your next Activated Card Effect this turn. When you have a Pre-match card with an Activated Card Effect in your Ring, you cannot play a Pre-match card with the same title. You may not pack Venues.

name: Zeke's Intimidating Clothesline
Text: When you are Ezekiel Jackson, you have lower Fortitude, and your Fortitude Rating is 5 or less, this card is F: 0. ACE: During your opponent's turn, you may remove this card from the game to reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card or any Run-in, and he overturns 4 cards; when you are The Corre, put this card in your Backstage instead.

name: Ziggler's Running Leg Drop
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played card. When played after a 4D+ maneuver, your opponent cannot reverse this card with D: 0 reversals from hand. He discards 1 random card.
